jobs.title: General Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
Wise Staffing Group is NOW HIRING multiple Warehouse Associates in the West Chicago, IL area! Multiple shifts available!


Job Summary:

We are seeking a Warehouse Associate to join a fast-paced warehouse and distribution operation. This position supports inventory management, shipping, receiving, and order fulfillment. This role is responsible for performing hands-on warehouse duties, including picking, packing, sorting, material handling, and inventory activities.


Responsibilities:

  • Receive, inspect, store, pick, and pack products to support daily shipping and fulfillment operations.
  • Safely operate warehouse equipment to move materials throughout the facility.
  • Perform inventory counts and maintain accurate inventory records.
  • Pick and pack orders accurately and efficiently.
  • Assist with shipping and receiving activities as needed.
  • Load, unload, move, and organize materials throughout the warehouse.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Follow all company safety procedures and warehouse operating guidelines.
  • Perform a combination of equipment operation and manual warehouse tasks throughout the shift.


Qualifications:

  • Previous warehouse experience required.
  • Cherry picker experience preferred.
  • Ability to lift, carry, move, and handle materials throughout the shift.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
  • Ability to perform repetitive physical tasks while maintaining productivity and accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.
  • Reliable attendance and dependable work ethic.


Why Wise Staffing Group:

  • Weekly pay
  • Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance
  • Temp-to-hire opportunity


Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Vision insurance


Work Location: In person

Company Description

Headquartered in Tupelo, MS, Wise Staffing Group is a full-service human resources company specializing in temporary and career staffing with an emphasis on providing excellent customer service. Wise Staffing Group become one of the largest staffing services in the Southeast United States. Since 1987, we have proven to be one of the most respected providers of innovative staffing solutions. We have developed and offer industry leading services that provide dependable, qualified workers. Each office sets and maintains the same high standards of operation and ongoing commitment to quality services. We consistently work toward superior performance in fulfilling client needs.

jobs.title: Warehouse Specialist
jobs.via: via Frito Lay Jobs - Search Hires Today
jobs.description:
Job Description

Warehouse Specialist help drive the success of Frito-Lay's warehouse and distribution operations by ensuring products are accurately received, stored, and prepared for delivery. This role supports inventory flow, order fulfillment, and warehouse organization while maintaining a strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational efficiency. If you enjoy physical work, value accuracy, and thrive in a fast-paced team environment, you'll find rewarding opportunities to contribute to our supply chain every day.

What You'll Do

  • Accept inbound deliveries by unloading trailers and inspecting products for accuracy and condition.

  • Pick, sort, and stage merchandise for outbound shipments in accordance with warehouse processes and customer requirements.

  • Operate forklifts, electric pallet jacks, and other material-handling equipment after successfully completing required training.

  • Move inventory throughout the warehouse and store products in designated locations using established handling procedures.

  • Check product quantities, labels, and shipping documents to help maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Assist with cycle counts, inventory replenishment, stock rotation, and warehouse organization efforts.

  • Build, wrap, and stabilize pallets to ensure products are protected during storage and transportation.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area by completing housekeeping tasks and identifying potential hazards.

  • Follow company policies, food safety guidelines, and warehouse operating procedures to support a safe workplace.

  • Coordinate with warehouse teammates, supervisors, and transportation personnel to meet daily shipping, receiving, and service objectives.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years old.

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on operational requirements.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, pull, and relocate products throughout the work shift.

  • Ability to remain on your feet for extended periods while walking, bending, reaching, climbing, kneeling, and performing repetitive physical movements.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow written and verbal instructions accurately.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented warehouse environment.

  • Previous experience in warehouse, logistics, manufacturing, distribution, or material handling is helpful but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse duties throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in an environment that may include varying temperatures, moving equipment, and moderate to high noise levels.

  • Safely operate powered industrial vehicles and warehouse equipment while following established safety practices.

Skills & Competencies

  • Dedication to workplace safety

  • Effective teamwork and communication

  • Dependability and accountability

  • Accuracy in inventory and order handling

  • Planning, organization, and time management

  • Critical thinking and sound decision-making

  • Ability to perform efficiently in a fast-paced warehouse setting

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, relies on dedicated warehouse professionals to help move products efficiently throughout its distribution network. As a Warehouse Specialist, you'll play an important role in receiving, storing, and shipping products while supporting safe warehouse operations, maintaining inventory accuracy, and delivering the dependable service our customers expect.

Q: How physically demanding are Frito-Lay production jobs?

A: Production and warehouse positions can be physically demanding and may involve prolonged standing, repetitive movements, lifting, bending, and working extended shifts. Employees are also expected to follow strict workplace safety procedures.

Q:How many hours is part-time at Frito-Lay?
A: Part-time roles generally run under 30 hours/week, though hours can start low and Frito-Lay is often quick to offer more hours to reliable workers.

Q:Does Frito-Lay pay overtime?
A: Yes — 71% of surveyed employees said they receive overtime pay for their role at Frito-Lay. Some part-time reviewers note overtime access can be limited.

Q:How often do Frito-Lay employees get paid?
A: Most reviews indicate Frito-Lay pays weekly.

jobs.title: Forklift Operator - Part Time
jobs.via: via Women For Hire- Job Board
jobs.description:
Pay Rate: $20.58 per hour

Schedule: Mon, Weds & Fri 5pm - 11:30pm

The Forklift Operator is responsible for the safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, staging, scanning, and movement of freight. As certified forklift operators within the operation, they provide safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, movement, and documentation of cargo/freight within a multimodal transportation terminal, intermodal yard, warehouse, or dock environment, directly contributing to productivity, workflow coordination, and freight integrity. As the most experienced team members without direct reports, they often assist with mentoring, guiding, and onboarding new Material Handlers and solving complex operational problems on the floor.

Responsibilities

  • Load and unload freight using sit-down/stand-up forklifts and reach trucks, along with other appropriate Material Handling Equipment (MHE), such as pallet jacks, carts, and dollies, and approved physical lifting techniques.
  • Move, stage, sort, and position freight between dock doors, trailers, and designated warehouse areas in accordance with operating procedures.
  • Pick, pack, and prepare items for shipping and delivery.
  • Assist drivers with loading and unloading activities following dock and safety procedures.
  • Label, scan, and track freight using handheld scanning devices and company systems to ensure accuracy and documentation integrity.
  • Identify damaged freight and promptly report issues, unsafe conditions, or equipment concerns to supervisory personnel.
  • Abide by all company safety policies, OSHA requirements, and PPE standards.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized dock environment, including work areas, tools, and MHE.
  • Perform tasks under appropriate supervision while learning equipment operation, safety protocols, and job procedures (for developing roles).
  • Support dock productivity, workflow efficiency, and overall operational goals.
  • Work assigned schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on business needs.
  • Safely and accurately handle oversized, high‑value, or complex freight.
  • Assist with dock coordination, workflow management, and problem resolution.
  • Prioritize freight and coordinate task assignments, sometimes acting in a lead capacity (without direct supervisory responsibility).
  • Serve as a subject‑matter expert on dock operations, equipment, and procedures.
  • Train, mentor, and support the development of other Material Handlers.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

Qualifications

  • Education: High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED)/equivalent preferred but not required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Valid forklift certification/licensure (or ability to obtain before operating equipment) required.
  • Experience: 3+ years of dock or warehouse experience required.
  • Communication: Ability to communicate effectively in English, verbally and in writing, to understand safety and operational instructions, work assignments, and freight documentation.
  • Ability to recognize numbers, labels, barcodes, and freight markings accurately, and to perform basic arithmetic to verify freight counts, quantities, and weights.
  • Basic arithmetic skills to verify freight counts, quantities, and weights.
  • Technology: Willingness and ability to learn and use basic computer systems, handheld scanners, and freight-tracking devices.
  • Equipment: Ability to safely operate material handling equipment (MHE) such as pallet jacks, dollies, hand trucks, order pickers, pallet riders, conveyors, dock plates, dock levelers, sit-down/stand-up forklifts and reach trucks (with company-assisted certification/training), and/or other specialized MHE as required by the site.
  • Ability to maintain regular and predictable attendance.
  • Physical Demands: Extensive standing, walking, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and twisting for 8-12 hours per/shift, with the ability to lift, push, pull, and carry freight up to 50lbs without assistance, with occasional lifting of freight up to 75lbs with assistance or mechanical aids throughout each 8-12 hour shift, multiple times per/week.
  • Vision, hearing, and verbal communication skills sufficient to work safely in a noisy dock environment.
  • Environment: Ability to work safely around moving equipment, vehicles, and freight in a non-climate-controlled environment, including frequent exposure to temperature extremes (both hot and cold), occasional outdoor work and/or exposure to precipitation (rain, sleet, snow, etc.), regular exposure to moving equipment, vehicle traffic, exhaust, dust, and moderate to loud noise.

jobs.description:
Summary

Manually loads bread onto conveyors and manages equipment racks while ensuring strict quality control through label verification and shortage reporting. Maintains department hygiene and adheres to all safety protocols to ensure a smooth production flow.

Essential Functions

  • Lifts hot 25-pound loaves of bread from conveyor and places it on the racks.
  • Frequently pushing/pulling of full racks into their correct order.
  • Ensure batch numbers and product code on the labels match.
  • Return any unused label back to the supervisor so that it can be recorded.
  • Performs department Sanitation as needed (Dry cleaning/Wet Washing).
  • Detect any malfunction and report it to the supervisor.
  • Comply with all safety requirements and company policies.
  • Report all shortage to the lead operator.
  • Perform other related duties as needed.

Benefits

  • Medical Insurance
  • Prescription Drug Plan
  • Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Employee Incentive Plan
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Cash Accumulation Plan-401K
  • Life/AD&D Insurance
  • Short- Term/Long-Term Disability
  • Vacation Plan
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Adoption Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Maternity/Paternity Leave
  • Pet Insurance

Salary

  • Starting at $19.18- $22.57 an hour.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent education, training or experience (GED)
  • The employee will be required to lift and handle objects weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • The employee will regularly lift, bend, push, and pull.
  • Able to communicate well, both verbal and written, also with good mathematical skills.

Work Environment

  • Maintain cleanliness of work areas and equipment; follow proper lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures when required.
  • Follow all safety rules, food safety standards, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), and company policies.
  • Report shortages, inconsistencies, or quality concerns to the lead operator or supervisor.
  • This position operates in warehouse and production environments with exposure to strong aromas, airborne dust particles from ingredients, and industrial machinery. Employees must follow all safety procedures and use the required personal protective equipment (PPE).

Chicago Role Highlights

At a Glance

  • Earn extra cash with a stable local employer.

Day-to-Day

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

It sounds too good to be true — part-time hours with full-time quality benefits. But at UPS, it has been the reality for decades, and it is one of the primary reasons our part-time workforce has some of the highest retention rates in the logistics industry. Our Part-Time Warehouse positions with benefits are the rare exception in the American labor market — roles where Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision coverage, pension contributions, and paid personal time are available to associates working as few as 17.5 hours per week. When you search for warehouse jobs with benefits near me, nothing else on the market delivers what UPS does at the part-time level.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I took this job because my family needed health insurance and I could not afford individual coverage. UPS's Teamsters medical plan costs me a fraction of what individual insurance costs, covers my entire family, and is genuinely better coverage than what my spouse gets at their full-time job. I work 20 hours a week, I am home by 9:30 AM every morning, and my family's healthcare is completely handled. For anyone searching for warehouse jobs with benefits at part-time hours, UPS is completely in its own league." - Current Part-Time Associate with Benefits, Nashville, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Warehouse Associate with Benefits, you work a structured 3.5 to 5 hour sort shift inside our package center, performing the core loading, sorting, and unloading functions that keep the UPS delivery network running — and accessing a benefits package that most part-time employers do not even attempt to offer.

  • Core Sort Functions: Execute UPS's standard sort operation tasks — unloading trailers, sorting packages on conveyor systems, and loading delivery vehicles in sequence order — building skill and speed across all three functions over time on a consistent part-time schedule.
  • Benefits Enrollment Navigation: Work with UPS's onboarding team to enroll in Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision benefits, understand your pension accrual schedule, and register for the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program within your first weeks on the job.
  • Consistent Schedule Reliability: Maintain consistent attendance across your assigned part-time shift window — the foundation on which your Teamsters union seniority, annual wage progression, and long-term benefits eligibility are all built.

Benefits & Perks

This UPS part-time position includes the full Teamsters union benefits package — medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and eligible dependents, a defined-benefit pension plan, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance covering up to $25,000 in education costs. Weekly paychecks and contractual annual wage progression raises complete a benefits offering that no comparable part-time warehouse job with benefits in this market can match.

About UPS & Our Culture

Four to five hours. That is all UPS asks of its morning preload associates — and in return, you receive Teamsters union wages, full medical benefits, a pension contribution, and a completely free day starting before 9:30 AM. Our Part-Time Morning Warehouse position is the best-kept secret in the local job market for parents who need school-drop-off mornings free, freelancers who want their afternoons uninterrupted, and anyone who simply values owning their day. When you search for morning warehouse jobs near me that pay well and end early, UPS preload is the answer that consistently surprises people who find it.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I drop my kids off at school at 7:45 AM and I am already done with my UPS shift. I work 4:00 AM to 8:30 AM, and the entire rest of my day belongs to me. The union wage plus the morning shift differential adds up to a paycheck that covers my car payment and insurance with money left over. I have recommended this to every parent I know who is looking for morning warehouse jobs near me — nothing else in this market ends this early and pays this well." - Current Morning Preload Associate, San Antonio, TX.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Morning Warehouse Associate, you work the preload sort shift — typically 4:00 AM to 8:30 AM — inside our package center, sorting inbound overnight freight and building outbound package car loads that every UPS driver depends on to run a clean, efficient delivery route throughout the day.

  • Early Morning Inbound Sort: Process inbound overnight package volume from the network's linehaul trailers, sorting every parcel to the correct outbound car or lane using barcode scanning and load chart reference during the critical pre-departure window.
  • Package Car Load Building: Build delivery vehicle loads in precise stop-sequence order, ensuring every driver can pull their route efficiently from the first stop to the last without searching for misplaced freight inside the vehicle.
  • Shift Completion by 9 AM: Consistently finish your sort assignment and vehicle inspection before the morning departure window, freeing your entire day for family, school, freelance work, or a second career without any schedule conflict whatsoever.

UPS Part-Time Morning Associates earn a meaningful early-morning shift differential on top of Teamsters union base wages, with full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance — all on a schedule that ends before most people finish their morning coffee. Weekly direct-deposit paychecks make this one of the most financially practical morning warehouse jobs available anywhere in the logistics market.

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Package Logistics.

  • This East Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in East Chicago, IN is growing.
  • Benefit from working in East Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. About UPS & Our Culture

Precision is the promise UPS makes to every customer, and our Quality Control team is the internal force that keeps that promise intact. QC Associates audit the sort operation in real time — catching misloads, verifying scan compliance, and inspecting load quality before a single truck leaves the building. If you are searching for analytical UPS warehouse jobs that reward a sharp eye and a methodical mindset over raw physical speed, Quality Control is the most intellectually engaging role on the sort floor. These are warehouse jobs that directly protect the UPS service guarantee and drive some of the strongest internal logistics careers in our operations network.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"QC work suits my personality perfectly. I am not the fastest loader in the building, but I can spot a misload in three seconds and I find the audit process genuinely satisfying. Management noticed my accuracy rate and I was moved into a quality trainer role within a year. The UPS internal track rewards precision just as much as speed, and that is something most warehouse jobs never offer." - Current Quality Control Associate, Minneapolis, MN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Quality Control Warehouse Associate, you conduct real-time audits of sort accuracy, load quality, and scan compliance across the active sort floor inside our package center, catching errors before they generate service failures for UPS customers.

  • Misload Auditing: Systematically scan packages inside loaded package cars against the assigned route manifest, identifying any package loaded into the wrong vehicle and immediately correcting the misload before the driver departs.
  • Scan Compliance Verification: Audit sort belt scan rates in real time, identifying packages that bypassed the scan tunnel without a valid read and manually scanning them into the system to maintain chain-of-custody accuracy.
  • Load Quality Inspection: Walk loaded package cars before departure to verify that load quality meets UPS standards — no overhanging packages, heavy items on shelves not floors, fragile items in protected positions — documenting violations and coaching loaders immediately.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Quality Control Associates receive Teamsters union wages, full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program. The analytical nature of this role creates a direct pathway into UPS operations management and industrial engineering career tracks.

About UPS & Our Culture

College is expensive. UPS makes it dramatically less so. Our Part-Time Warehouse positions for students are built around one of the most generous employer education programs in America — the UPS Earn & Learn program, which pays up to $25,000 directly toward your tuition while you work short sort shifts that end before your first class of the day begins. When students search for part-time jobs for students that offer genuine financial benefits beyond the paycheck, UPS sits in a category of its own. A Teamsters union wage, real medical benefits, and tuition funding on a 4-to-5 hour shift — there is no part-time student job in the logistics industry that matches this combination.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I found this job specifically because I needed help paying tuition and I did not want to work 30 hours a week to do it. UPS pays my tuition directly through Earn & Learn, my shift ends by 9 AM, and the union medical plan replaced the expensive student health insurance I was carrying. My grades have actually improved because I am less financially stressed. This is genuinely the best part-time job for students I have ever heard of — and I have told every person in my program about it." - Current Student Warehouse Associate, Boston, MA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

This UPS Part-Time Warehouse position is specifically structured around a student schedule — early morning or evening sort shifts of 3.5 to 5 hours that fit before class, after class, or between your academic obligations inside our package center, without requiring you to sacrifice study time or sleep.

  • Earn & Learn Tuition Enrollment: Enroll in the UPS Earn & Learn tuition program after meeting eligibility requirements and receive direct tuition payments toward your accredited degree program — money paid directly to your institution, not reimbursed after the fact.

This is the most financially impactful part-time job for students in the logistics industry, period.

About UPS & Our Culture

Saturday and Sunday belong to UPS — and we pay exceptionally well for them. Our Weekend Fulfillment Worker positions are specifically designed for professionals, students, parents, and side-hustle seekers who need every weekday completely untouched. These weekend fulfillment center jobs deliver Teamsters union wages plus a weekend differential on just two days of work, making them one of the highest-value part-time income opportunities in the logistics market. If you have been searching for weekend warehouse jobs near me that pay real union money and leave your Monday-through-Friday life completely intact, UPS weekend fulfillment is exactly what you have been looking for.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I am a full-time teacher during the week and a UPS Weekend Fulfillment Worker on Saturday and Sunday. The two days of union wages plus the weekend differential cover my car payment, my phone bill, and my gym membership with money left over. I never touch my teaching salary for those expenses anymore. Weekend fulfillment center jobs like this are rare — most weekend warehouse work pays minimum wage, but UPS pays a union rate that actually moves the needle financially." - Current Weekend Fulfillment Worker, Charlotte, NC.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Weekend Fulfillment Worker, you process the elevated Friday-through-Sunday package volume that accumulates through the week and peaks during weekend consumer ordering windows inside our fulfillment center, executing sort and load functions across Saturday and Sunday shifts while keeping every weekday of your schedule entirely free.

  • Weekend Volume Surge Processing: Handle the above-average weekend package volumes generated by Friday evening, Saturday, and Sunday consumer orders, working at a pace that clears the weekend's sort accumulation before Monday morning delivery routes begin.
  • Saturday & Sunday Sort Execution: Work the weekend sort window — typically an afternoon or evening shift on both days — processing packages through the correct outbound lanes and loading completed pallets onto outbound trailers with the same accuracy standards UPS maintains across every sort shift of the week.
  • Weekend Differential Tracking: Understand and confirm your weekend shift differential on every weekly paycheck — the additional pay rate that UPS applies to weekend hours on top of the Teamsters base wage and that makes two days of weekend fulfillment work financially meaningful.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Weekend Fulfillment Workers earn Teamsters union wages plus a weekend shift differential for Saturday and Sunday hours, Teamsters medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance — all without touching a single weekday hour of your schedule. Weekly paychecks direct-deposited every Friday. Your entire Monday-through-Friday life remains completely your own.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Distribution Center Associate are an important part of the Frito-Lay team, helping keep products moving safely and efficiently throughout our warehouse and distribution network. In this role, you'll receive, store, organize, and transport products while supporting daily warehouse operations and preparing orders for customer delivery. Your work helps ensure inventory accuracy, operational efficiency, and the timely distribution of our products.

We're looking for reliable individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, take pride in delivering quality work, and are committed to maintaining a safe workplace while supporting their team.

Responsibilities

  • Receive, unload, and move products, pallets, and materials throughout warehouse and shipping areas.

  • Pick, pack, stage, and prepare customer orders according to established procedures and delivery schedules.

  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other warehouse equipment after successfully completing required training and certification.

  • Store and transport products using proper handling techniques while following inventory rotation and storage guidelines.

  • Confirm product quantities, labels, and shipment documentation to help maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Support inventory management by assisting with cycle counts, stock replenishment, and product organization.

  • Assemble, wrap, and prepare pallets to ensure products are secure and ready for shipment.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area by completing routine housekeeping and sanitation responsibilities.

  • Follow all company safety policies, food safety standards, and warehouse operating procedures.

  • Collaborate with warehouse associates, supervisors, and transportation teams to meet productivity, shipping, and customer service goals.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Available to work flexible schedules, including weekends, holidays, overtime, and varying shifts based on business needs.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, and pull warehouse materials throughout the workday.

  • Capable of standing, walking, bending, reaching, climbing, kneeling, and performing repetitive physical activities for extended periods.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

  • Previous experience in warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or material handling is preferred but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse duties throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in an environment with changing temperatures, moderate to high noise levels, and active warehouse equipment.

  • Safely operate material-handling equipment while complying with all workplace safety requirements.

Skills & Competencies

  • Safety-focused mindset

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Reliability and consistent attendance

  • Accurate product handling and inventory control

  • Effective time management and organization

  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities

  • Ability to perform efficiently in a fast-paced warehouse environment

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, relies on dedicated warehouse professionals to keep our supply chain moving. As a Distribution Center Associate, you'll play a key role in ensuring products are received, stored, prepared, and shipped accurately, helping deliver the quality snacks our customers expect while supporting safe and efficient warehouse operations.

Q: What is the difference between a Route Sales Representative and a warehouse role?

A: Route Sales Representatives visit stores, manage inventory, stock products, and maintain customer relationships. Warehouse employees focus on receiving, organizing, picking, packing, and preparing products for distribution.

Q: What kind of training do new Frito-Lay employees receive?

A: New employees typically receive on-the-job training specific to their position, including job procedures, safety requirements, equipment use, and performance expectations.

Q: How physically demanding are Frito-Lay production jobs?

A: Production and warehouse positions can be physically demanding and may involve prolonged standing, repetitive movements, lifting, bending, and working extended shifts. Employees are also expected to follow strict workplace safety procedures.

Q:How often do Frito-Lay employees get paid?
A: Most reviews indicate Frito-Lay pays weekly.

As a Product Picker and Packer, you will be responsible for gathering, organizing, and preparing products for outbound shipments while ensuring precise order fulfillment. Your work will contribute directly to smooth warehouse processes and overall productivity.

  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other warehouse equipment safely and efficiently.

jobs.description:
Your Impact at Lowe’s

As a Receiver/Stocker, you help keep the store clean, safe, and ready for customers by accurately receiving freight, stocking shelves, and organizing merchandise and top stock. You’ll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success.

This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. And when a customer or teammate needs help, you’ll be there with a friendly, professional attitude.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe’s is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe’s associate, you’ll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Your Day at Lowe’s

You’ll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace. You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver SMART customer service by assisting customers, answering questions, and offering support during projects
  • Stock merchandise by unloading freight, down-stocking, organizing shelves, and setting up pallets
  • Support store operations by verifying deliveries, completing dock prep, and using equipment like pallet jacks and forklifts
  • Maintain a safe, clean environment by following proper procedures for hazardous materials, equipment use, and housekeeping
  • Operate store equipment including scanners, Zebra phones, balers, and other tools as needed
  • Pitch in as a team player to complete other assigned tasks

Additional responsibilities for Pro Fulfillment Stores include:
  • Use the Orders App to pick and stage Flatbed Delivery orders
  • Load delivery orders, ensuring quality, accuracy, and safe loading practices
  • Rotate orders by delivery date and resolve customer order issues
  • Proactively communicate with customers to ensure delivery satisfaction
  • Execute Delivery Readiness best practices

Minimum Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable

Preferred Qualifications
  • 3 months Experience operating forklift/power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment
  • 6 months Experience in a warehouse performing inventory handling and stocking

Lowe’s commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we actively seek and encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel, but occasional travel may be needed for meetings, training sessions, or to support nearby stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

About Lowe's

Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week, with total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion. Lowe’s employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

Job Description:

The 2023 US Best Managed Company Award recognizes companies that outperform their competition in the four critical areas of management: strategic planning, effective execution, culture, and governance/financial performance. As a recipient of this accolade, Coke Florida has distinguished itself as a leader among U.S. private organizations.

What We Offer:

If you are a full-time employee at Coke Florida, you are eligible to enroll in our Total Rewards Program and take advantage of its many offerings:

  • The all-inclusive plans for wellness consist of medical, dental, and vision coverage that aims to provide complete health support to the employees
  • The employer-sponsored 401K plan includes a healthy company match, ensuring employees receive even higher returns on their contributions
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • The company provides its employees with 11 paid holidays and a vacation pay for three weeks annually
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • EAPs may offer a variety of services, including counseling, legal and financial advice, substance abuse treatment, and referrals to community resources
  • Competitive compensation

The Winter Haven Coke Florida site necessitates a Warehouse Lead, and we are hiring for the first shift.

What you will do:

The primary responsibility of a Coke Florida Warehouse Supervisor is to oversee the storage and shipping of materials.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Assumes responsibility for a group of 25-30 warehouse workers
  • Developing a team requires coaching, guiding, collaborating, and enhancing the abilities of those who work together
  • Administer the regular functions of the storage establishment
  • Arrange Warehouse Team Members to Meet Demands of Facility
  • Dedicate a section of your storage area for the proper rotation of goods
  • Assist with the regulation of inventory levels and mitigate the likelihood of product loss
  • Oversee the handling and storage of goods during transportation and upon arrival
  • Secure company assets
  • Adopting cost-cutting measures can help organizations manage labor and OPEX budgets effectively

Attention to detail is essential, as you will be dealing with important information and sensitive client data:

  • The minimum educational requirement for this position is either a high school diploma or its equivalent, the GED
  • This role requires a minimum of two years' relevant experience in the warehouse or distribution field
  • Experience in managing both human and financial resources is a must-have for this position
  • Employers require candidates to possess leadership skills and have at least two years' experience in a warehouse or distribution supervisor role
  • The skill to manage a manual or powered pallet jack proficiently is a fundamental necessity for all individuals responsible for transporting goods
  • You must have forklift certification before starting your job

Having a broad range of skills, knowledge, and experience can make you an invaluable addition to the team. Expanding your expertise in different areas, such as marketing, data analysis, or project management, can show that you are adaptable, flexible, and capable of handling various tasks and projects:

  • Advanced Excel experience
  • Familiarity with the efficient management of inventory systems and aptitude with SAP software preferred

The role requires a significant amount of physical effort, which means:

  • The talent to repeatedly raise, carry, and position bulky objects weighing up to 50 pounds without any help is mandatory
  • The position demands that the individual has the strength to push and pull items weighing no more than 50 pounds. The tasks should be executed while bending at the knees, kneeling, squatting, and reaching at different levels
  • The competency to use manual transport equipment (e.g. pallet jack or hand truck) to move product loads repeatedly for a distance of at least 100 yards without any assistance
  • The skill to repeatedly take hold of and operate objects that come in various sizes and weights that require deft finger movements and coordination between the hands and eyes
  • The capacity to sustain physical efforts for prolonged periods of time is a vital requirement for individuals who are involved in jobs that necessitate continuous manual labor
  • Flexibility in Reading Small, Medium, and Large Print
  • Demonstrating the ability to stand for a minimum of 8 hours while at work, and potentially extending up to 10 hours
  • The requirement to walk a minimum of 4 hours during the workday
  • Frequently perform tasks within an environment that is hot and humid indoors
  • The aptitude to equip an auditory aid to comprehend directions delivered in the English tongue

Other details:

  • Job Family: Warehouse
  • Job Function: Warehouse
  • Pay Type: Salary

Coke Florida may update this job description at any time and assign further duties and responsibilities as necessary.

The employee's ability to perform the essential job functions to satisfaction is a prerequisite to employment at Coke Florida. The company may offer reasonable accommodations to disabled employees to enable them to perform their job duties, provided it does not cause undue burden.

All applicants and employees are treated with respect, dignity, and consideration irrespective of their background or identity.

jobs.description:
Forklift Driver-Bedford Park, IL

Posting Start Date: 6/22/26

G3 Enterprises Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Why G3?

G3 Enterprises is an industry leader in packaging, logistics, real estate and minerals solutions. Our diverse portfolio of businesses create a variety of opportunities for career growth. We believe in fully leveraging the talent within our organization, presenting employees with challenging work, opportunities for job rotations, special projects, and a changing landscape.

Apply Today! We Exist for You to Succeed.

Job Description:

Summary
Under minimal supervision, loads and unloads trucks, inspects incoming parts for freight damage. Moves
raw materials or finished goods and other commodities in specified locations of warehouse. Submits and
inputs data via keyboard, barcode scanner or written sheets to control inventory movement. Pulls raw
materials or finished goods cases using a Warehouse Management System (WMS) for inventory
transactions. Responsible for inventory count and labeling. Works independently between multiple
warehouses and campuses as needed.

Essential Functions
This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict
the tasks that may be assigned.
• Works on a broad range of direct and indirect tasks, from simple to complex, across multiple
campuses as needed.
• Loads and unloads various types of freight.
• Works within the Warehouse Management System to receive and ship loads (including Swisslog,
Softeon, SAP, etc.)
• Performs cycle counts through WMS reports on a frequent basis as required and supports
inventory control.
• Troubleshoots warehouse management system and inventory issues.
• Process outbound and inbound shipments and paperwork, are completed timely and accurately.
• Maintains all safety standards, 5S principles, GMP, and PPE requirements, Lean (where
applicable). Maintains a clean, safe, and orderly work area.
• Communicates across shifts to shift leader (and team, as applicable) to ensure proper work
transition.
• Conducts standard audits daily utilizing safety checklist, taking corrective action as needed (i.e.
checking oil and charging forklift).
• Records quality outcomes using established forms.
• Inspects inventory for defects.
• Demonstrates teamwork within a diverse team, working closely throughout each shift.
• Follows and practices all established Standard Operating Procedures.
• Supports and practices all established safety programs and policies.
• Maintains satisfactory attendance, to include timeliness.
• Responsible for understanding and complying with applicable quality, environmental and safety
regulatory considerations.
• Operates equipment to move goods/material handling
• Loads and unloads inbound and outbound inventory onto freight containers, cargo trailers, and
rail cars as needed by location.
• Operates multiple types of equipment such as floor scrubber, pallet jack, etc.
• Attends and participates in company committees such as Safety Committee.

Qualifications
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The
requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and ability required. Reasonable
accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Minimum Qualifications
• High school diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus 2 years of experience in material
handling and forklift driving; OR High school diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus
current Forklift Certification and 1 year of G3 experience in material handling and forklift driving.
• Ability to obtain FLD certification within 30-60 days of employment.
• Required to lift and move up to 50 pounds.
• Basic PC knowledge.
• Experience with handling various sizes of palletized product.
• Required to work 8 hours shift with the ability to work 12 hour shifts, day or night shift, on multiple
campuses as needed.
• Able to work overtime as needed.

Preferred Qualifications
• High school diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus current Forklift Certification and 4
years of experience in material handling and forklift driving.
• Experience with Clamp, Double fork, and Pull Pack Fork Lift attachments.
• Experience loading and unloading rail cars.
• Experience with electric stand-up lifts.
• Skilled in comprehending simple instructions, short correspondence and memos such as email.
• Experience conveying simple requests and needs to coworkers and management.
• Skilled in adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing.
• Skilled in maintaining a clean, safe and orderly work area.
• Experience with using company resources in a cost-effective manner.
• Experience reading and interpreting documents such as BOL, instruction sheets, safety rules,
operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
• Experience with working in a team environment

Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to
successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable
individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit on a lift truck and drive
in and out of vans and containers. The employee is occasionally required to handle or feel; reach with
hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and
move up to 50 pounds and clean-up any leaking or spilled liquids caused by broken containers that they
were responsible for moving. Specific vision requirements are peripheral vision, depth perception, and
focus adjustment.

Work Environment
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters
while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable
individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be occasionally exposed to outside weather
conditions, fumes or airborne particles, and toxic or caustic chemicals. The employee is frequently
exposed to moving parts. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud. The work
environment may not be temperature controlled and potential exposure to natural weather conditions.

Compensation

Hiring Hourly Rate: $21.01 - $24.66

Actual compensation amount paid may be lower or higher to be determined by factors other than race and gender such as the education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

Perks & Benefits

This position includes a competitive benefits package.

jobs.title: Delivery Station Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
Amazon Delivery Station Warehouse Associate

Job Overview

You’ll be part of the dedicated Amazon team at the delivery station – the last stop before we deliver smiles to customers. Our fast-paced, active roles receive trucks full of orders, then prepare them for delivery. You’ll load conveyor belts, and transport and stage deliveries to be picked up by drivers.
Basic Job Requirements

  • Be 18 years or older
  • Understand and follow instructions in English
  • Lift up to 49 pounds
  • View prompts on screens and follow direction for some tasks
  • Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  • Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  • Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  • Work in an environment with varying temperatures and moving vehicles
What You’ll Do

  • Receive and prepare packages for delivery
  • Use technology like smartphones and handheld devices to sort, scan, and prepare orders into delivery bags and vans
  • Build, wrap, sort, and transport pallets and packages
  • Receive truck deliveries of customer packages
Schedule Options

  • Shift Options. Early Morning and Overnight hours.
  • Weekly Hours. Full-Time (40 hours), Reduced-Time (30-39 hours), Part-Time (20-29 hours), Flex-Time (minimum 4 hours/week).
  • Schedule Flexibility.Choose from a Fixed or Flexible Schedule.
  • Overtime Opportunities. Your shift could be extended or reduced by additional hours based on customer demand and will be communicated during your shift.
What it’s like at an Amazon Delivery Station

Safety Your Workspace

  • Safety. Your safety is our top priority. We provide protective gear and all teams share safety tips daily. Our state-of-the-art facilities are clean, well-organized, and designed with your safety in mind.
  • Equipment.You’ll be operating and working around moving equipment—mobile cards, rolling cages, etc.
  • Physical Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
Work Conditions

  • Temperature.Climate-controlled facilities maintain temperatures between 60°F and 90°F in most areas. On hot days, temperatures can exceed 90°F and on cold days temperatures can reach below freezing.
  • Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  • Dress code.Relaxed and comfortable. Closed-toe shoes required. Protective safety footwear required in select areas.$110 Zappos gift code provided for your first day.
Why Youll Love Amazon

Compensation

  • Benefits.Many of our shifts come with a range of benefits that may include pay and savings options, healthcare, peace of mind for you and your family, and more.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

The 2023 US Best Managed Company Award recognizes companies that outperform their competition in the four critical areas of management: strategic planning, effective execution, culture, and governance/financial performance. As a recipient of this accolade, Coke Florida has distinguished itself as a leader among U.S. private organizations.

What We Offer:

If you are a full-time employee at Coke Florida, you are eligible to enroll in our Total Rewards Program and take advantage of its many offerings:

  • The all-inclusive plans for wellness consist of medical, dental, and vision coverage that aims to provide complete health support to the employees
  • The employer-sponsored 401K plan includes a healthy company match, ensuring employees receive even higher returns on their contributions
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • The company provides its employees with 11 paid holidays and a vacation pay for three weeks annually
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • EAPs may offer a variety of services, including counseling, legal and financial advice, substance abuse treatment, and referrals to community resources
  • Competitive compensation

The Winter Haven Coke Florida site necessitates a Warehouse Lead, and we are hiring for the first shift.

What you will do:

The primary responsibility of a Coke Florida Warehouse Supervisor is to oversee the storage and shipping of materials.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Assumes responsibility for a group of 25-30 warehouse workers
  • Developing a team requires coaching, guiding, collaborating, and enhancing the abilities of those who work together
  • Administer the regular functions of the storage establishment
  • Arrange Warehouse Team Members to Meet Demands of Facility
  • Dedicate a section of your storage area for the proper rotation of goods
  • Assist with the regulation of inventory levels and mitigate the likelihood of product loss
  • Oversee the handling and storage of goods during transportation and upon arrival
  • Secure company assets
  • Adopting cost-cutting measures can help organizations manage labor and OPEX budgets effectively

Attention to detail is essential, as you will be dealing with important information and sensitive client data:

  • The minimum educational requirement for this position is either a high school diploma or its equivalent, the GED
  • This role requires a minimum of two years' relevant experience in the warehouse or distribution field
  • Experience in managing both human and financial resources is a must-have for this position
  • Employers require candidates to possess leadership skills and have at least two years' experience in a warehouse or distribution supervisor role
  • The skill to manage a manual or powered pallet jack proficiently is a fundamental necessity for all individuals responsible for transporting goods
  • You must have forklift certification before starting your job

Having a broad range of skills, knowledge, and experience can make you an invaluable addition to the team. Expanding your expertise in different areas, such as marketing, data analysis, or project management, can show that you are adaptable, flexible, and capable of handling various tasks and projects:

  • Advanced Excel experience
  • Familiarity with the efficient management of inventory systems and aptitude with SAP software preferred

The role requires a significant amount of physical effort, which means:

  • The talent to repeatedly raise, carry, and position bulky objects weighing up to 50 pounds without any help is mandatory
  • The position demands that the individual has the strength to push and pull items weighing no more than 50 pounds. The tasks should be executed while bending at the knees, kneeling, squatting, and reaching at different levels
  • The competency to use manual transport equipment (e.g. pallet jack or hand truck) to move product loads repeatedly for a distance of at least 100 yards without any assistance
  • The skill to repeatedly take hold of and operate objects that come in various sizes and weights that require deft finger movements and coordination between the hands and eyes
  • The capacity to sustain physical efforts for prolonged periods of time is a vital requirement for individuals who are involved in jobs that necessitate continuous manual labor
  • Flexibility in Reading Small, Medium, and Large Print
  • Demonstrating the ability to stand for a minimum of 8 hours while at work, and potentially extending up to 10 hours
  • The requirement to walk a minimum of 4 hours during the workday
  • Frequently perform tasks within an environment that is hot and humid indoors
  • The aptitude to equip an auditory aid to comprehend directions delivered in the English tongue

Other details:

  • Job Family: Warehouse
  • Job Function: Warehouse
  • Pay Type: Salary

Coke Florida may update this job description at any time and assign further duties and responsibilities as necessary.

The employee's ability to perform the essential job functions to satisfaction is a prerequisite to employment at Coke Florida. The company may offer reasonable accommodations to disabled employees to enable them to perform their job duties, provided it does not cause undue burden.

All applicants and employees are treated with respect, dignity, and consideration irrespective of their background or identity.

jobs.title: Air Cargo Warehouse Agent -ORD
jobs.description:
Take a Huge step in your career and join Worldwide Flight Services. WFS employs over 22,200 of the finest professionals in ground handling across a global network of more than 170 locations and 22 countries on five continents. A career with us opens up a world of opportunities to develop your existing skills, to learn new skills, and to experience working with different customers and cultures with the sole aim of always delivering a world-class service. WFS provides a full-service capability that includes Aviation cargo, Airline passenger, and Aviation ramp services. Our team of people is highly trained, highly skilled, and confident airport service professionals who are supported by local training and development. We are passionate, capable, and always willing to explore new opportunities presented by customers all over the world.

Air Cargo Warehouse Agent -ORD

About WFS

Join our Worldwide Flight Services family and contribute to the timely delivery of cargo shipment, business to customer delivery, and on-time flights while operating safely and securely. We perform at the highest level for our customers every day, and strive to be an exceptional leader in our industry with our teams of cargo, passenger, ramp handling, and technical service experts in 164 airport locations, 18 countries, and on 5 continents. Are you ready to take off on your next career with us?

Job Summary

The work of a Warehouse Agent includes the following: loading and unloading of cargo; the receiving, delivering, and physical handling of freight and company material, export at the designated docks, the completion of forms and messages related to and necessary for the performance of the designated locations of the functions described. May be assigned to perform routine cleaning of work areas, ramps, and facilities with or without powered equipment. May be assigned to assist in monitoring security of facility. Comply with WFS site security procedures for assigned warehouse and other operations. Remain cognizant of WFS staff, security contractors, and visitors’ activities and report security breaches, suspicious occurrences, or non-compliance with the site security plan to managers or via the WFS whistleblower program.

Curious to learn more about what we do, please click the link below:

https://jobs.wfs.aero/content/Day-In-The-Life-Cargo/?locale=en_US

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for moving air cargo within designated warehouse.
  • Load and unload cargo from pallets and containers.
  • Build up cargo for outbound flights.
  • Break down cargo from import flights.
  • Facilitate the loading and unloading of cargo to and from semitrucks.
  • May operate basic cargo handling equipment such as forklift, aircraft pallets and pallet jacks.
  • Check freight for proper piece count, weight, dimensions and documents as appropriate when accepting or delivering cargo.
  • Confirm Dangerous Goods (DG) have been checked within aircraft limits and Follow specific procedure for DG shipments when received, including when shipment is abandoned by consignee.
  • Ability to understand and react to verbal commands and safety warnings, with and without, assistance of sight or visual aids.

Minimum Requirements

  • HS Diploma, GED or Equivalent
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Valid driver's license
  • Ability to work rotating shifts including weekends (i.e., Friday, Saturday, Sunday), holidays, and days off.
  • This job is covered by a collective bargaining agreement of the Transport Workers Union (TWU), a labor union which requires joining the TWU and paying union dues.**

Preferred Skills

  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand the English language.

Physical Requirements/Working Conditions

  • Ability to lift up to 80 lbs.
  • Ability to work in all types of weather conditions as well as environmental conditions, i.e., jet engine fumes, vehicle emissions, dust, and jet engine noise.
  • Ability to distinguish colors, red, green, and yellow.

Perks & Benefits

  • Want your pay in advance? Access your pay when you need it through DailyPay app!
  • Are you a top performer who thrives on recognition? On the spot awards offered through the Awardco Platform including gift cards and more!
  • Need quality medical care? Multiple options for both full and part-time employees!
  • Want WFS Employee Extras? Travel Discounts, Pet insurance, Discount Shopping & More!
  • Looking to stay healthy and improve your life? Wellness Programs offered to all employees!
  • Want to invest in your future? 401k program offered!
  • Looking to grow and have a career with us? Opportunity for Internal Mobility and transfers available!

WFS is an equal opportunity employer committed to employment equity and inclusion. We accept applications from all qualified individuals.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

About UPS & Our Culture

Most warehouse employers demand experience before they will even interview you. UPS is different. We hire driven, motivated people and train them to be exceptional — no prior warehouse experience required, no resume full of logistics jobs needed. Our overnight sort shift is the single best entry point into a UPS career for first-time warehouse workers, career changers, and anyone who has never worked in a distribution center before. When you search for no experience warehouse jobs, you will not find a better starting line than a UPS overnight shift. We offer real Teamsters union wages, real medical benefits, and the kind of paid training that turns complete beginners into skilled operators within weeks.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I had zero warehouse experience when I applied. I had been working retail and wanted something with better pay and real benefits. UPS hired me on the spot, trained me completely on my first shift, and within thirty days I was one of the faster sorters in my area. The overnight differential on top of the union wage is more money than I made at my retail job working twice the hours. If you are searching for no experience warehouse jobs near me, stop looking — this is the one." - Current Overnight Warehouse Associate, Las Vegas, NV.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Overnight Warehouse Associate with no prior experience needed, you will be fully trained on your first shift and supported by experienced team leads throughout your entire qualification period inside our package center. Overnight shifts typically run 10:30 PM to 3:30 AM, leaving your entire day free.

  • Paid On-The-Job Training: From your very first shift, a UPS-certified on-job trainer walks beside you, demonstrating every method step by step — no prior experience required, no knowledge assumed, no worker left to figure it out alone.

  • Safety Method Mastery: UPS's injury-prevention training is among the most comprehensive in the industry — your trainer teaches proper lifting, lowering, and equipment interaction techniques before you handle a single package unsupervised.

Benefits & Perks

No experience is required to access UPS's full benefit package — medical, dental, and vision coverage through the Teamsters union, a defined-benefit pension plan, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program worth up to $25,000. The overnight shift differential adds significant income on top of the base union wage. Your days remain completely free. Weekly paychecks start from your very first week on the job.

Hourly

Our teammates are the cornerstone of our organization.

Job Overview:

1st Shift

Schedule:

Primarily work Monday to Friday, with opportunities for overtime on weekends or beyond if necessary

Hours:

6:00am-2:30pm

With expertise in using material handling equipment like forklifts and pallet jacks, the General Warehouse Laborer is equipped to move, load, and unload materials throughout the facility and surrounding area.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Select vending and cold drink equipment that can effectively serve the sales requests.
  • It's crucial to utilize protective wrapping and attach the proper documentation (STO) to guarantee the safety and security of all outbound loads.
  • Follow CCCI's SOPs when aiding in the loading and unloading of trailers to assist with delivery operations. Use handhelds to update SAP and CONA, keeping track of inbound and outbound loads to ensure accuracy and accountability for the territories served by the Regional Operation Center.
  • Emphasize safety and cleanliness by completing all necessary pre- and post-trip evaluations, double-checking daily documentation for accuracy, and ensuring a tidy and obstacle-free work area.
  • Participate in various duties as directed, such as staging equipment and managing yard work, such as removing clutter and maintaining a neat appearance.
  • Use a switching system to move pup and 53' trailers to the docking location as needed.

There are certain traits that individuals must possess in order to be successful in their professional role. These traits are often referred to as knowledge, skills, and abilities, or KSAs

  • Proficient understanding of essential safety principles, including proper lifting methods and the adoption of personal safety clothing.
  • Possess expert-level forklift skills required to operate single-wide forklifts with finesse and accuracy.
  • Basic pallet-jack skills.
  • Elementary competence in mechanics and uncomplicated employment of tools.
  • Knowledgeable in handling different rudimentary machines.
  • Following written guidelines or instructions is essential for best practices.
  • Generate reports through handwritten or computer-based formats to track progress.
  • Follow verbal instructions.
  • Intermediate math skills.
  • A holistic understanding of the aspects that bolster productivity.
  • The ability to analyze the process of order building, optimize the loading workflow, and select the most efficient pick and load path.
  • Managing various processes at the same time is a fundamental part of maintaining an optimized system.
  • The skill of consistently counting incoming products and verifying them against the manifest is critical.
  • Consistently achieving accurate loading of trucks while following documentation requirements.
  • Exhibits superior interpersonal communication skills.
  • The job necessitates the ability to perform in extreme temperatures, noisy surroundings, slippery floors, and hazardous shards of glass.
  • Every once in a while, the requirement may arise to lift weights that exceed 25 pounds, although the frequency of such cases is low.
  • The capacity to remain seated for extended periods.
  • Regular movements on and off a forklift.
  • The opening and closing of truck dock doors play an essential role in the unloading and loading process.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Certification for forklift and pallet jack operation includes both theoretical and practical training to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Switcher operation certification.
  • Obtaining a Class A commercial driver's license is mandatory in some cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Past familiarity with logistics handling.
  • It is critical to adhere to federal and state weight limitations to avoid fines and citations. Failing to comply with regulations can also lead to accidents and damage to the truck, trailer, and cargo.

Work Environment:

  • An environment that is both loud and lacks temperature regulation, varying between both high and low degrees.

Job Summary:

As a Fortune 50 company with over 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and a leader in American retail. Working at Target provides the opportunity to help families experience the joy of everyday life. We are deeply committed to supporting our communities, investing in the places we live, work, and play. Our team values relationships, fosters talent growth, and thrives together as one. At our core, we prioritize care, growth, and success together.

Roles and Duties:

  • Adhere to all safety policies and protocols to establish a safe work environment.
  • Engage in safety training programs to enhance your performance capabilities in a swiftly moving warehouse environment.
  • Handle the packaging, transportation, and distribution of goods for consumers and stores.
  • Ensure the meticulous management of products for retail fulfillment and customer drop-offs.
  • Ensure the smooth transportation of goods and effective inventory handling throughout the warehouse.
  • Make sure your workspace is clutter-free, organized, and clean at all times.
  • Timely attendance at work is crucial, along with accurately completing tasks as scheduled.
  • Work on addressing issues to foster continuous operational improvements.
  • Express a proactive and polite attitude when carrying out responsibilities independently or as a team member.

  • Able to frequently lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs.
  • Able to occasionally lift and carry items up to 60 lbs.
  • Proficiency in maintaining an upright position, navigating, applying force, dragging, crouching, flexing, and extending during working hours.
  • Sustain a positive and professional approach whether in a team or independent work setting.
  • Core math competencies that entail counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Competency in accurately comprehending and interpreting information found on labels, tickets, and other product-related documents.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in operating computer systems or handheld devices with minimal supervision following appropriate training.
  • Proficient in expressing thoughts verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to understand, converse in, and interpret English to follow safety guidelines, policies, and instructions effectively.

  • Proficient in following instructions and utilizing powered machinery safely (e.g., Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit-Down & Stand-Up Forklift).

  • Experienced in operating effectively in temperature-managed environments, such as refrigerators and freezers, over long periods.

Target team members may qualify for a comprehensive benefits package, subject to plan terms and employment eligibility. Employees also receive a 10% Target discount, plus an extra 20% off select wellness products, including fruits, vegetables, healthy foods, activewear, and tobacco cessation products.

Based on business needs and role requirements within Warehouse Operations, candidates may be considered for either a Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate position. The specific job responsibilities for each role are outlined in the application process.
