jobs.description:
Yard & Warehouse Laborer – Tire Recycling

K&S Tire Recycling is hiring dependable, hardworking individuals to join our yard and warehouse team in Chicago Heights, IL.

This is a hands-on, physically demanding position for someone who is comfortable working in an industrial environment and wants steady work with an established, growing company.

What You’ll Do

As a Yard & Warehouse Laborer, you will help keep tires and other recyclable materials moving safely and efficiently throughout our facility.

Daily Responsibilities Include

  • Load and unload tires from trucks, trailers, and containers
  • Move tires by hand and with hand trucks/dollies
  • Sort, stack, organize, and stage tires
  • Grade and inspect used tires based on condition and quality
  • Move and sort other scrap and recyclable materials
  • Maintain organized tire and material storage areas
  • Assist with general warehouse and yard operations
  • Perform general cleanup and housekeeping throughout the facility
  • Work safely around forklifts, loaders, trucks, conveyors, and other moving industrial machinery
  • Follow company safety procedures and supervisor instructions
  • Perform other general labor duties as needed

Requirements

Physical Requirements

This is an active, physical job. Applicants must be able to:

  • Regularly lift, carry, push, and move materials weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Handle and move tires repeatedly throughout the workday
  • Stand, walk, bend, reach, push, pull, and lift for extended periods
  • Work both indoors and outdoors
  • Work in varying temperatures and weather conditions
  • Work safely in an active industrial environment around moving vehicles and machinery

What We’re Looking For

We Are Looking For People Who

  • Are dependable and show up to work on time
  • Are willing and able to perform physical labor throughout the shift
  • Have a strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Can follow directions and safety procedures
  • Work well as part of a team
  • Take pride in keeping their work area clean and organized
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-paced industrial environment

Minimum 1 year warehouse, tire, recycling, automotive, construction, landscaping, manufacturing, or general labor experience is required.

Benefits

Why Work With K&S Tire Recycling?

K&S Tire Recycling is a growing tire recycling company serving customers throughout the Midwest. Our operation keeps millions of pounds of tires and recyclable materials out of landfills and puts those materials back to productive use.

We value employees who are reliable, safety-conscious, hardworking, and willing to learn.

We offer accrued sick/vacation time.

We have 1st and 2nd shift positions available.

Compensation is $16-$18 per Hour USD

jobs.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic warehouse team as a Forklift Operator and Warehouse Worker, where you'll play a vital role in maintaining efficient warehouse operations. This energetic position offers the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art equipment, support inventory management, and ensure the safe handling of materials. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about safety and precision, this is your chance to contribute to a thriving logistics operation that values your skills and dedication.

Responsibilities

  • Operate various types of material handling equipment including forklifts, reach trucks, Hi-Lo, clamp trucks, pallet jacks, and barcode scanners to load, unload, and move products safely and efficiently.
  • Perform order picking using manual methods or order picker equipment to fulfill customer orders accurately and promptly.
  • Manage inventory by conducting regular stock counts, updating warehouse management systems (WMS), and ensuring proper storage of materials.
  • Assist with shipping and receiving tasks by verifying shipments against documentation, preparing goods for dispatch, and maintaining accurate inbound/outbound logs.
  • Conduct routine equipment inspections and perform basic repairs or coordinate maintenance to ensure all machinery operates safely according to OSHA standards.
  • Follow warehouse safety protocols including OSHA regulations, forklift safety standards, manual handling procedures, and heavy equipment operation guidelines to prevent accidents.
  • Support warehouse distribution activities by organizing storage areas, optimizing space utilization, and ensuring compliance with safety standards in production environments.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience operating forklifts (including reach trucks, Hi-Lo, clamp trucks) and other material handling equipment such as pallet jacks and lift trucks.
  • Strong understanding of warehouse management systems (WMS), barcode scanning for logistics, shipping & receiving procedures, and inventory management practices.
  • Knowledge of warehouse safety standards including OSHA regulations related to forklift operation, manual handling, heavy lifting, and general warehouse safety protocols.
  • Ability to perform heavy lifting consistently while adhering to manual handling best practices.
  • Basic math skills for inventory counts and order accuracy verification.
  • Prior experience in warehouse operations or distribution centers is highly preferred; warehouse supervisor experience is a plus.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational skills for managing multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Join us in creating a safe, efficient, and energetic workplace where your skills make a real difference!

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment
jobs.description:
Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment

Alice & Wonder | Chicago, IL 60642
Starting at $17.50/hour

About the Role

Alice & Wonder is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Warehouse Associate to join our Chicago warehouse team.

This position is primarily responsible for picking, packing, tagging, and preparing merchandise for our retail stores and online customers.

We're looking for someone who works efficiently, pays attention to the little details, and enjoys being part of a fast-moving team. You'll spend your day working with our products—picking merchandise, tagging clothing, preparing store transfers, packing online orders, checking product quality, and making sure orders leave our warehouse accurately and looking great.

Accuracy and productivity are the two biggest priorities in this role.

What You'll Do

Picking, Packing & Store Fulfillment

  • Pick merchandise accurately for store transfers and customer orders
  • Scan, pack, and prepare inventory transfers for our retail locations
  • Verify styles, sizes, colors, and quantities before orders are completed
  • Keep orders organized throughout the fulfillment process
  • Help ensure stores receive the right merchandise on time

Online Order Fulfillment

  • Pick and pack online customer orders accurately and efficiently
  • Inspect merchandise before packing to ensure it meets our quality standards
  • Prepare packages for shipment
  • Make sure orders are neat, accurate, and presentation-ready
  • Gift-wrap customer orders when requested

Tagging & Product Preparation

  • Tag and label clothing, accessories, and other incoming merchandise
  • Prepare new merchandise so it is ready for our stores and customers
  • Organize product by style, size, or designated inventory location
  • Identify damaged, defective, or incorrect merchandise
  • Communicate product or inventory discrepancies to the Warehouse Lead

Warehouse Support

  • Help count and verify incoming merchandise
  • Assist with inventory counts as needed
  • Restock and organize picking and packing areas
  • Keep your workstation and surrounding warehouse areas clean and organized
  • Work closely with warehouse, shipping, retail, and other teams
  • Pitch in with other warehouse tasks when needed

What We're Looking For

You could be a great fit if you:

  • Are dependable and consistently show up on time
  • Have strong attention to detail
  • Can work quickly without sacrificing accuracy
  • Are organized and like keeping things in the right place
  • Are comfortable working on your feet throughout your shift
  • Can follow established processes and instructions
  • Work well independently and as part of a team
  • Are comfortable doing repetitive tasks such as picking, packing, folding, tagging, and labeling merchandise
  • Take pride in sending out an accurate, well-presented order
  • Bring a positive attitude and are willing to help wherever needed

Previous retail, warehouse, inventory, stockroom, picking/packing, or fulfillment experience is helpful, but not required. We're happy to train the right person who is dependable, motivated, and willing to learn.

Physical Requirements

This is an active warehouse position that requires standing and moving throughout the workday.

The position regularly requires:

  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Bending, reaching, and moving around warehouse work areas
  • Picking merchandise from inventory locations
  • Packing, folding, tagging, and handling merchandise throughout the day
  • Lifting and carrying boxes weighing up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation

What Success Looks Like

Get the orders right and get them done.

Our stores receive the correct merchandise. Online customers receive the correct orders. Clothing gets tagged properly. Product is checked before it leaves the warehouse. Orders are completed efficiently, accurately, and on time.

You're someone the team can depend on to consistently get the details right.

About Alice & Wonder

Alice & Wonder is a Chicago-based retail company offering fun, unique, and affordable apparel, accessories, gifts, and more.

We're a growing local business with a hardworking, team-oriented environment. We move quickly, help each other out, and believe you can get a lot done while still having fun at work.

We're looking for people who want to be part of the team and contribute to what we're building.

What We Offer

  • Paid time off
  • Paid sick time
  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Fun, energetic work atmosphere
  • Team-oriented environment
  • Opportunity to learn different parts of a growing retail business
  • Employee growth opportunities

If you're organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and enjoy getting things done, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: From $17.50 per hour

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Flexible schedule
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

  • Are you able to stand and move throughout an 8-hour shift and lift/carry items weighing up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation?
  • Are you comfortable performing repetitive warehouse tasks such as picking orders, packing boxes, tagging clothing, folding merchandise, and preparing store transfers throughout your shift?
  • How many years of experience do you have in warehouse, retail stockroom, inventory, picking/packing, or order fulfillment?
  • Tell us about a job, school, or other experience where accuracy and attention to detail were important. What did you do to make sure your work was correct?

Work Location: In person

Description

Ready for more than just a job? Build a career with purpose.

At Lactalis in the USA, we’re committed to providing meaningful opportunities for our people to learn, grow, and thrive—whether you’re just starting your journey with us or looking to take the next step in your career. From day one, we offer the tools and support to help you succeed.

As the world leader in dairy, Lactalis is a family-owned company with over 85,000 pragmatic and ambitious professionals across the globe. Each day, we’re proud to produce award-winning dairy products that bring people together.

In the US, we proudly offer an unrivaled house of beloved brands, including Galbani® Italian cheeses and ricotta, Président® specialty cheeses and butters, Kraft® natural and grated cheeses, Breakstone’s® cottage cheese, Cracker Barrel®, Black Diamond® cheddar, and Parmalat® milk. Our yogurt portfolio includes siggi’s®, Stonyfield Organic®, Brown Cow™, Oui®, Yoplait®, Go-Gurt®, :ratio®, Green Mountain Creamery®, and Mountain High®, along with a growing family of ethnic favorites like Karoun®, Gopi®, and Arz®.

At Lactalis, we live by our core values—Ambition, Engagement, and Simplicity. We foster a workplace where innovation thrives, diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone’s unique background and ideas are valued.

Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. We want to hear about your PASSION, your STORY, and how your EXPERTISE can help us shape the future of dairy.

From your PASSION to ours

Lactalis USA, part of the Lactalis family of companies, is currently hiring a Sr. Analyst, Warehouse Management Systems based in Chicago, IL. As a Sr Analyst, Warehouse Management Systems, the role will carry out responsibilities such as supporting technical solution design, configuration support, integrations, enhancements, testing, deployment, and production support for Blue Yonder WM and related SAP-enabled Supply Chain Execution processes. The role includes working on Functional, technical specifications, interfaces, APIs, data mapping, reporting, troubleshooting, and integration with SAP Inventory Management, Materials Management, Sales/Distribution, Transportation, and Manufacturing processes. Additionally, the Technical Analyst will collaborate with functional analysts, business stakeholders, IT integration teams, and external partners to deliver stable, scalable solutions aligned with company goals and values.

Requirements

From your EXPERTISE to ours

Key Responsibilities For This Position Include

  • Strong hands-on Blue Yonder WM technical experience primarily in “Warehouse Management and Supply Chain Execution” processes.
  • Experience in integrating ERP/Host systems with Blue Yonder’s Warehouse Management Systems
  • Partner with functional analysts and business users to understand requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications and solution designs.
  • Develop, support, and troubleshoot technical objects such as interfaces, reports, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, integrations, and data extracts related to Blue Yonder WM.
  • Support system integrations between Blue Yonder WM to SAP ECC, middleware(Go Anywhere), EDI, APIs transportation, manufacturing, and third-party logistics applications.
  • Analyze BY interface failures, application errors, data mapping issues, transaction processing defects, and performance bottlenecks; document root cause and corrective actions.
  • Support API usage, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting for inbound, outbound, and internal warehouse processes.
  • Participate in system configuration reviews, technical impact assessments, design walkthroughs, unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and deployment readiness activities.
  • Prepare and maintain technical design documents, interface mapping documents, test evidence, cutover tasks, deployment checklists, and production support knowledge articles.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional IT teams, business process owners, and project teams to resolve integration and application issues.
  • Support large-scale BY WMS implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and legacy WMS replacement initiatives.
  • Ensure technical solutions follow IT standards for documentation, controls, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational support.
  • Provide hypercare and production support for Blue Yonder WM incidents, enhancement requests, and operational issues.
  • Comfortable working alongside business analysts and functional teams who provide requirements.
  • Experience with using / Testing APIs.
  • Experience in working with Native SaaS WMS solutions.
  • Minimum 2 years' experience working within Blue Yoder’s Warehouse Management Systems either as a customer of Blue Yonder or as a consultant implementing Blue Yonder solutions for customers.
  • Additionally relevant solutions consulting and implementation experience with other leading supply chain planning solutions such as SAP WM, Infolog is a plus.

From your STORY to ours

Qualified Applicants Will Contribute The Following

  • Bachelor's degree is required in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Management, Supply Chain Management, Logistics / Operations Management, or related field.
  • Preferred Blue Yonder WMS Technical Accreditation/certified.
  • 3+ years Strong Technical Experience in Blue Yonder Warehouse Management System is required.
  • Hands-on BY Warehouse Management process and integration with SAP ECC System (application and configuration) for global project implementations; food industry experience preferred.
  • Ensure Warehouse Process business requirements across Supply Chain Area and related functions are translated into detailed functional specifications.
  • Configure and test system processes; troubleshoot, document, and resolve system-related issues.

Certifications and specific knowledge

  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder Warehouse Management Processes is required.
  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder WM inbound, outbound, internal warehouse process and integration with transportation, manufacturing and SAP ECC system is required.
  • Knowledge of integration points and techniques with SAP system and logistics, as well as 3rd party applications is required.
  • Knowledge of integration points with SAP modules such as Invenorty Management, Procurement, Sales and Transportation planning are required.

About FedEx Supply Chain Inbound Receiving

Receiving Associates are the first hands that touch inventory when it arrives at a FedEx Supply Chain distribution center. Every pallet, carton, and loose item that flows into the facility must be verified against purchase orders, inspected for damage, scanned into the warehouse management system, and staged for put-away — all with zero tolerance for quantity errors that would cascade into picking inaccuracies and customer order failures downstream. Receiving is where inventory accuracy begins.

Position Overview

FedEx Supply Chain is hiring Receiving Associates to process inbound vendor shipments at distribution center facilities. You will unload inbound trailers, verify freight against purchase orders and advance ship notices, scan items into the WMS, and stage received inventory for forklift put-away. This is a daytime dock-side position critical to maintaining downstream inventory accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload inbound vendor trailers using pallet jacks, transferring palletized and loose freight to the receiving staging area.
  • Verify received quantities and SKUs against purchase orders, flagging overages, shortages, and damaged items immediately.
  • Scan all received inventory into the warehouse management system, generating put-away tasks for forklift operators.
  • Inspect inbound freight for visible damage, documenting exceptions with photographs and carrier damage reports.
  • Stage verified pallets in designated put-away lanes organized by storage zone for efficient forklift processing.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No prior receiving or warehouse experience required — full training provided. Strong counting accuracy and attention to detail essential. Must lift up to 50 lbs and work at dock-side receiving areas. FedEx Supply Chain offers competitive receiving associate pay, daytime shift schedules, weekly paychecks, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) matching, tuition assistance, and advancement into inventory control and lead positions.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. Local Job Overview: Chicago

Job Title: Overnight Warehouse Associate (Gig/Contract) Hiring Organization: Amazon Based in: Chicago, IL (our growing Chicago office)

Compensation: $21-$25/Hour (approx. $48.4k/Year) Benefits: This role offers competitive pay. Set your own schedule.

Day-to-Day

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Logistics.

  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our Amazon team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Logistics industry.

Rule the Night, Fuel the Morning

While the rest of the city sleeps, the Amazon network kicks into its highest gear. The night shift is the undisputed powerhouse of our distribution model. Everything accomplished overnight determines the success of the delivery fleet the following morning. If you are a dedicated night owl seeking highly lucrative Amazon warehouse jobs with less congestion and massive earning potential, the Overnight Warehouse Associate role is your perfect entry into thriving logistics careers.

Why the Graveyard Shift Dominates

Working the overnight shift (typically 6:00 PM to 4:30 AM or similar) offers distinct lifestyle advantages. Your commute is entirely devoid of rush-hour traffic. The warehouse floor, free from daytime administrative tours, feels more focused and tightly knit. The camaraderie among the night crew is legendary within the company. Most importantly, you are financially rewarded for your hours with substantial "shift differentials" added directly to your base hourly wage.

Core Nightly Objectives

  1. High-Octane Order Processing: Your primary directive is to clear the digital backlog of orders placed during the evening. You will heavily engage in rapid picking and packing operations to ensure all parcels hit the loading dock before the critical dawn dispatch deadlines.
  2. Sortation and Palletizing: You will sort the completed, labeled packages by their final zip codes, meticulously stacking them onto pallets and wrapping them securely for the local delivery stations that dispatch at sunrise.
  3. Facility Reset and Staging: In the final hours of your shift, you will help reset the massive facility. This includes clearing cardboard debris, sweeping aisles, and fully restocking the packing stations with tape, boxes, and dunnage so the incoming day shift can hit the ground running.

Night Shift Rewards and Benefits

The financial perks of the night shift are undeniable, but they come paired with Amazon's legendary corporate benefits. You do not sacrifice quality of life for working nights. You receive the exact same Day 1 healthcare, dental, and vision insurance as daytime employees. You gain immediate access to our 401(k) matching program and the incredible Career Choice tuition coverage. If you are 18+, can lift up to 49 pounds, and thrive in the moonlight, apply today.

Diesel Mechanic

Under the immediate direction of the Senior Mechanic, the Diesel Mechanic performs repairs on mobile equipment, including ready mix trucks, front end loaders, and trailers. 60/40 work split between Shop and mobile repairs at Concrete Ready Mix plants.

Requirements

  • Observes and listens to truck in operation to determine malfunctions.
  • Use diagnostic software to do advanced troubleshooting
  • Reads manuals, uses hand tools, power tools to perform repairs and maintenance to electrical systems, power transmissions, brakes, drivelines and other automotive systems to perform repair work
  • Replaces rollers and other wear items as required
  • Performs welding, repair and fabrication
  • Assists Senior Mechanic as needed
  • Performs data entry on all services performed
  • Operates mobile equipment as needed
  • Delivers technical advice to Ready Mix Truck Drivers and other mobile equipment operators.
  • Maintains parts inventory and orders of parts and supplies as needed
  • Demonstrates good knowledge of lock out/tag out procedure required during certain procedures
  • May make service calls at other plants or emergency roadside repairs as needed
  • Assists with training co-workers as needed
  • General clean-up of work areas
  • Follows safety policies and procedures as written
  • Participates in the shop safety program and conduct tailgate safety meeting.
  • Performs other duties as required

Preferred Education and Experience

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent GED required
  • Minimum 2 years Mobile Equipment Maintenance Experience, Ready Mix Maintenance experience preferred
  • Trade School or related mechanical / technical certification
  • Commercial Driver License (CDL) and safe driving record

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of repair and maintenance of diesel engines, hydraulics, electrical, transmissions, brakes, drivelines and other automotive systems to perform repair work
  • Basic welding skills
  • Ability to read and write in English
  • 40 hours per week and overtime on an as needed basis

Physical Requirements

  • Work requires the ability to climb stairs, climb ladders, reach, squat, tolerate prolonged standing/walking, balance, bend from trunk, operate mobile equipment, crawl, kneel, push and pull objects

Job Description:

Pay Range:

The amount offered for this position is between $18.00 to $19.38 per hour and may vary depending on the candidate's experience

Rate Frequency:

Hourly

Our teammates are the cornerstone of our organization.

With our company, you'll enjoy outstanding benefits, a competitive salary, opportunities for career advancement, and avenues for personal and professional growth.

Benefits are also granted to Full-time crew members:

  • Paid Training
  • Staff members enjoy a combination of remunerated PTO and public holidays
  • 401(k) Savings with Employer Matching on a 1-to-1 Basis
  • Companies use ESPP as a way to retain employees by offering a unique benefit
  • Medical coverage pays for the costs of medical care, including doctor visits, hospitalization, and prescription drugs
  • Basic and supplemental life insurance plans are designed to provide financial support to the family of the policyholder in the unfortunate event of their death

We offer the necessary tools and resources to help you climb the career ladder and reach new heights of success

Job Overview:

1st Shift

Schedule:

Primarily work Monday to Friday, with opportunities for overtime on weekends or beyond if necessary

Hours:

6:00am-2:30pm

With expertise in using material handling equipment like forklifts and pallet jacks, the General Warehouse Laborer is equipped to move, load, and unload materials throughout the facility and surrounding area.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Select vending and cold drink equipment that can effectively serve the sales requests.
  • It's crucial to utilize protective wrapping and attach the proper documentation (STO) to guarantee the safety and security of all outbound loads.
  • Follow CCCI's SOPs when aiding in the loading and unloading of trailers to assist with delivery operations. Use handhelds to update SAP and CONA, keeping track of inbound and outbound loads to ensure accuracy and accountability for the territories served by the Regional Operation Center.
  • Emphasize safety and cleanliness by completing all necessary pre- and post-trip evaluations, double-checking daily documentation for accuracy, and ensuring a tidy and obstacle-free work area.
  • Participate in various duties as directed, such as staging equipment and managing yard work, such as removing clutter and maintaining a neat appearance.
  • Use a switching system to move pup and 53' trailers to the docking location as needed.

There are certain traits that individuals must possess in order to be successful in their professional role. These traits are often referred to as knowledge, skills, and abilities, or KSAs

  • Proficient understanding of essential safety principles, including proper lifting methods and the adoption of personal safety clothing.
  • Possess expert-level forklift skills required to operate single-wide forklifts with finesse and accuracy.
  • Basic pallet-jack skills.
  • Elementary competence in mechanics and uncomplicated employment of tools.
  • Knowledgeable in handling different rudimentary machines.
  • Following written guidelines or instructions is essential for best practices.
  • Generate reports through handwritten or computer-based formats to track progress.
  • Follow verbal instructions.
  • Intermediate math skills.
  • A holistic understanding of the aspects that bolster productivity.
  • The ability to analyze the process of order building, optimize the loading workflow, and select the most efficient pick and load path.
  • Managing various processes at the same time is a fundamental part of maintaining an optimized system.
  • The skill of consistently counting incoming products and verifying them against the manifest is critical.
  • Consistently achieving accurate loading of trucks while following documentation requirements.
  • Exhibits superior interpersonal communication skills.
  • The job necessitates the ability to perform in extreme temperatures, noisy surroundings, slippery floors, and hazardous shards of glass.
  • Every once in a while, the requirement may arise to lift weights that exceed 25 pounds, although the frequency of such cases is low.
  • The capacity to remain seated for extended periods.
  • Regular movements on and off a forklift.
  • The opening and closing of truck dock doors play an essential role in the unloading and loading process.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Certification for forklift and pallet jack operation includes both theoretical and practical training to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Switcher operation certification.
  • Obtaining a Class A commercial driver's license is mandatory in some cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Past familiarity with logistics handling.
  • It is critical to adhere to federal and state weight limitations to avoid fines and citations. Failing to comply with regulations can also lead to accidents and damage to the truck, trailer, and cargo.

Work Environment:

  • An environment that is both loud and lacks temperature regulation, varying between both high and low degrees.

Employment opportunities are available to qualified individuals, without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Weekly paychecks and contractual annual wage progression raises complete a benefits offering that no comparable part-time warehouse job with benefits in this market can match.

We have a job opening for a full-time 2nd Shift Shipping Supervisor in our Chicago, IL distribution center. The primary role of the Shipping Supervisor is providing leadership and direction for the Shipping department in this location; overseeing handling of merchandise for shipment and departmental staff as efficiently, safely and productively as possible, to ensure that customer expectations are exceeded. Shift time includes 1:00pm to 10:00pm; overtime required.
Essential Functions:
  • The Shipping Supervisor will be responsible for overall management of the Shipping Department in the Chicago location.
  • Responsibilities include organizing the daily workload of department and directs employees accordingly. Works to ensure freight and packages are being moved to destinations on time.
  • Play a key role in interviewing and hiring quality staff members; overseeing a strong training regimen for new staff; continuously developing new and experienced workers; managing staff; and completing performance management reviews on assigned employees twice a year.
  • Oversees and is directly involved (hands on) in the following Shipping operations: productivity, quality, freight handling, including, but not limited to, customer service, and safety. This role is responsible for ensuring prompt, efficient and accurate handling of merchandise as well as developing and implementing team goals.
  • In addition to supervising Shipping staff, this position is also responsible for providing leadership by example while assisting with daily shipping functions. This includes performing duties, such as building and consolidating pallets of customer shipment; organization and staging of the department; preparing orders for shipment with external carriers, such as UPS and FedEx and other various duties.
  • Ensures that departments keep a clean and orderly work environment. Assigns general custodial tasks and establishes cleaning schedule for areas. Supports a healthy and safe work environment by communicating unsafe conditions immediately.
  • Maintains warehouse equipment to ensure safety of employees; addresses any mechanical issues that are reported.
  • Works proactively to foster and maintain a positive team-oriented atmosphere at all times.
  • Other duties as assigned.
What You will Need to be Successful:
  • High school diploma, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of three years of related experience required and one year in warehouse operations or distribution is preferred.

  • Must be able to lift/pull/carry at least 70 pounds; must be willing/able to stand and walk for entire shift, often over 8 hours. With or without accommodation.
  • Strong customer service, problem solving, time management, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to effectively build relationships are essential.
  • Self-starter with a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively as a member of a team.
  • Successfully pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check and drug screening.
Work Location:
  • This role is located in Chicago, IL.

Compensation: $65,000-$70,000 annually.

jobs.description:
Position Warehouse Associate
Location Chicago Heights, IL
Company UPS
Pay Rate $25.50/hr
Job Type Part-Time
Urgency
Highlights Weekly Pay

Chicago Heights Alert: We are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate to join our local team. This is an excellent opportunity for anyone looking for part-time work with $25.50/hr potential.

Tags: #ChicagoHeightsJobs #PartTime #Warehouse



About UPS & Our Culture

Full-time employment at UPS is one of the most sought-after positions in American blue-collar work — and for good reason. Our Full-Time Warehouse Associates are Teamsters union members earning contractually guaranteed wages, working inside one of the most technologically advanced distribution center networks on earth. When you search for full-time warehouse jobs that offer weekly pay, comprehensive benefits, and a genuine long-term career path, the UPS full-time warehouse associate role consistently sits at the top of every honest comparison. We build careers here — not just shifts — and the associates who commit to UPS full-time consistently build lives their peers envy.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"Going full-time at UPS was the single best career decision I have ever made. The Teamsters contract gives me wages, benefits, and job security that my friends in other industries genuinely cannot believe. My medical coverage is better than what most white-collar professionals receive, my pension is real and growing, and I have a clear path to a driver salary that will set my family up for decades. This is what a full-time warehouse job is supposed to look like." - Current Full-Time Warehouse Associate, Chicago, IL.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Full-Time Warehouse Associate, you work a structured daily shift inside our package center, operating across the full range of warehouse functions — loading, unloading, sorting, and staging — with the stability of a permanent schedule, guaranteed weekly hours, and a Teamsters contract behind every paycheck.

  • Full-Shift Sort Operations: Execute the complete daily sort cycle — inbound unloading, package sorting, and outbound loading — across an 8-hour structured shift with dedicated break periods, consistent start times, and a predictable weekly schedule you can plan your life around.
  • Cross-Function Expertise: Develop mastery across multiple warehouse functions over time, becoming a versatile full-time associate capable of leading in any area of the sort operation where the shift manager needs experienced coverage.
  • Mentorship of Part-Time Associates: As an experienced full-time presence, model UPS safety methods and load quality standards for newer part-time team members, helping the facility's overall accuracy and safety performance rise every shift.

Benefits & Perks

Full-Time Warehouse Associates receive the complete Teamsters union benefit package — medical, dental, and vision insurance, a defined-benefit pension plan, paid vacation, paid sick leave, and paid holidays. Weekly direct-deposit paychecks, annual contractual wage progression raises, and priority consideration for full-time driver openings make this one of the most financially rewarding full-time warehouse jobs available in any market.

What You'll Do

  • This role centers on your professional skills within the Logistics space in East Chicago.

Mastering the Overnight Middle Mile

If the fulfillment center is the brain of the operation, the sortation center is the central nervous system. Welcome to the critical "middle mile" of the Amazon delivery network. As a Night Shift Sortation Warehouse Associate, your primary objective is to group and route thousands of packages during the graveyard hours so they reach the correct local delivery hubs right at dawn. For those seeking highly active, fast-paced night shift warehouse jobs that offer intense teamwork and rapid physical movement, this is the ultimate environment.

The Overnight Sortation Experience

Work in a sort center is fundamentally different from a traditional fulfillment role. You are not picking individual items; you are dealing with sealed, completed packages that are moving rapidly down vast networks of conveyor belts. The atmosphere at night is charged, highly focused, and incredibly team-oriented. When the conveyor belts get heavily loaded during the midnight "rush," you will rely on your night-owl teammates to clear the lines and keep the supply chain moving seamlessly.

  1. Rapid Package Routing: You will read complex digital routing labels as packages fly down the line, pulling them off the belt and sorting them into specific geographical chutes or designated postal carts.
  2. Pallet Architecture: You will become a master of spatial reasoning. Sorting requires building perfectly stable, tightly packed pallets of boxes (often referred to as "playing Tetris" by our veteran associates), which are then heavily shrink-wrapped to prevent transit damage.
  3. Fluid Loading Operations: Utilizing manual pallet jacks, you will safely transport these massive, wrapped pallets directly into the bellies of outbound 18-wheeler semi-trailers, staging them for the early morning over-the-road drivers.

"The night sort center moves incredibly fast, but the overnight shift premium is what keeps me here. Working the graveyard shift allows me to manage my college classes during the day while still getting access to Amazon's incredible 401(k) matching and tuition assistance. The night crew is like a family." - A current Night Sortation Associate.

Flexibility and Night Shift Rewards

We understand that modern life requires flexible schedules. Sortation roles offer some of the most adaptable late-night shifts in the logistics careers landscape, including midnight to morning or late evening options. Associates unlock exceptional health, dental, and vision benefits, along with highly competitive shift differentials that significantly boost your base pay when working non-traditional hours. You will need a strong commitment to workplace safety, the ability to lift up to 49 pounds, and a High School diploma or equivalent to join the night team.

jobs.title: Clif Bar Warehouse Team Member (Night Shift 600pm - 600am)
jobs.description:
## Join Us in Leading the Future of Snacking

Are you ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? We’re the team behind iconic brands like Oreo, Ritz, and Chips Ahoy!, and we’re looking for a motivated Warehouse Team Member to join our Indianapolis plant on the night shift.

### What You’ll Do

You’ll play a hands-on role in our warehouse operations, ensuring materials move safely and efficiently from receiving to production to shipping. Your days will be varied and fast-paced. You'll operate stand-up counterbalance forklifts, reach trucks, and powered pallet jacks, and use SAP-EWM or RF systems to manage everything from put-away to replenishment. Supporting the Vongal palletizer and inline wrapper operations will also be part of your routine — you’ll keep material flowing and address minor jams, escalating bigger issues to maintenance.

You’ll also:
- Replenish raw and packaging materials into production areas and dough room kits
- Handle trailer loading and unloading, following strict dock safety controls (wheel chocks, gladhand locks, dock lights)
- Use the pallet inverter to transfer materials between wood, plastic, or CHEP pallets
- Complete all SAP transactions accurately for goods movements, confirming lot codes and quantities

### What Safety & Quality Look Like Here

Safety isn’t just a poster on the wall — it’s how we work. You’ll wear required PPE (safety shoes, hearing protection, high-visibility vest), perform daily pre-use inspections on powered equipment, and tag out any machine that needs service. Every near miss or unsafe condition is reported immediately. Food safety is also critical: you’ll inspect materials for damage or contamination, maintain allergen control, and ensure proper segregation of Good/Hold/Reject items.

### Systems & Inventory Accuracy

You’ll keep our inventory visible and accurate in real time by executing warehouse transactions in SAP-EWM/ECC. Cycle counts, wall-to-wall inventories, and reconciling physical vs. system counts will be part of your routine. If you spot a discrepancy, you’ll escalate it promptly to inventory control or supervision.

### Continuous Improvement & Teamwork

We believe in always getting better. You’ll take part in IL6S, Kaizen, and 5S initiatives that improve safety, quality, and efficiency. You’ll keep your workspace clean, organized, and audit-ready, and you’ll communicate regularly with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Logistics teams. If you have experience to share, you’ll help train new team members by modeling safe, standardized work practices.

### What You’ll Need

**Required:**
- High school diploma or GED
- At least 3 years experience in a warehouse, distribution, or manufacturing environment
- 2+ years operating Powered Industrial Vehicles (PIV), including stand-up counterbalance and stand-up reach forklifts
- Familiarity with SAP-EWM or other WMS, plus RFID use
- Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and work in a food-grade environment
- Strong adaptability to take on diverse responsibilities

**Preferred:**
- Experience with automated palletizing or packaging equipment (Vongal, inline wrappers)
- Prior work in food manufacturing, 3PL, or consumer goods
- Knowledge of IL6S, Lean, or 5S principles

### Work Environment & Schedule

This is a warehouse and production floor setting with variable temperatures, exposed to forklifts, conveyors, palletizers, and moderate noise levels. The night shift runs 6:00pm to 6:00am on a 2-2-3 schedule — you’ll work two days, have two off, then work three, repeating the pattern.

### Compensation & Benefits

The hourly wage for this position is **$23.09/hr**. You’ll also be eligible for an annual incentive program targeting 5% of your salary. Mondelez International offers a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, wellness programs, family support resources, life and disability insurance, a 401K retirement savings plan, paid leave, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time — many of which are subsidized or fully paid by the company.

Mondelez Global LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: General Warehouse Laborer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Pay Range:

The amount offered for this position is between $18.00 to $19.38 per hour and may vary depending on the candidate's experience

Rate Frequency:

Hourly

Our teammates are the cornerstone of our organization.

With our company, you'll enjoy outstanding benefits, a competitive salary, opportunities for career advancement, and avenues for personal and professional growth.

Benefits are also granted to Full-time crew members:

  • Paid Training
  • Staff members enjoy a combination of remunerated PTO and public holidays
  • 401(k) Savings with Employer Matching on a 1-to-1 Basis
  • Companies use ESPP as a way to retain employees by offering a unique benefit
  • Medical coverage pays for the costs of medical care, including doctor visits, hospitalization, and prescription drugs
  • Basic and supplemental life insurance plans are designed to provide financial support to the family of the policyholder in the unfortunate event of their death

We offer the necessary tools and resources to help you climb the career ladder and reach new heights of success

Job Overview:

1st Shift

Schedule:

Primarily work Monday to Friday, with opportunities for overtime on weekends or beyond if necessary

Hours:

6:00am-2:30pm

With expertise in using material handling equipment like forklifts and pallet jacks, the General Warehouse Laborer is equipped to move, load, and unload materials throughout the facility and surrounding area.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Select vending and cold drink equipment that can effectively serve the sales requests.
  • It's crucial to utilize protective wrapping and attach the proper documentation (STO) to guarantee the safety and security of all outbound loads.
  • Follow CCCI's SOPs when aiding in the loading and unloading of trailers to assist with delivery operations. Use handhelds to update SAP and CONA, keeping track of inbound and outbound loads to ensure accuracy and accountability for the territories served by the Regional Operation Center.
  • Emphasize safety and cleanliness by completing all necessary pre- and post-trip evaluations, double-checking daily documentation for accuracy, and ensuring a tidy and obstacle-free work area.
  • Participate in various duties as directed, such as staging equipment and managing yard work, such as removing clutter and maintaining a neat appearance.
  • Use a switching system to move pup and 53' trailers to the docking location as needed.

There are certain traits that individuals must possess in order to be successful in their professional role. These traits are often referred to as knowledge, skills, and abilities, or KSAs

  • Proficient understanding of essential safety principles, including proper lifting methods and the adoption of personal safety clothing.
  • Possess expert-level forklift skills required to operate single-wide forklifts with finesse and accuracy.
  • Basic pallet-jack skills.
  • Elementary competence in mechanics and uncomplicated employment of tools.
  • Knowledgeable in handling different rudimentary machines.
  • Following written guidelines or instructions is essential for best practices.
  • Generate reports through handwritten or computer-based formats to track progress.
  • Follow verbal instructions.
  • Intermediate math skills.
  • A holistic understanding of the aspects that bolster productivity.
  • The ability to analyze the process of order building, optimize the loading workflow, and select the most efficient pick and load path.
  • Managing various processes at the same time is a fundamental part of maintaining an optimized system.
  • The skill of consistently counting incoming products and verifying them against the manifest is critical.
  • Consistently achieving accurate loading of trucks while following documentation requirements.
  • Exhibits superior interpersonal communication skills.
  • The job necessitates the ability to perform in extreme temperatures, noisy surroundings, slippery floors, and hazardous shards of glass.
  • Every once in a while, the requirement may arise to lift weights that exceed 25 pounds, although the frequency of such cases is low.
  • The capacity to remain seated for extended periods.
  • Regular movements on and off a forklift.
  • The opening and closing of truck dock doors play an essential role in the unloading and loading process.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Certification for forklift and pallet jack operation includes both theoretical and practical training to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Switcher operation certification.
  • Obtaining a Class A commercial driver's license is mandatory in some cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Past familiarity with logistics handling.
  • It is critical to adhere to federal and state weight limitations to avoid fines and citations. Failing to comply with regulations can also lead to accidents and damage to the truck, trailer, and cargo.

Work Environment:

  • An environment that is both loud and lacks temperature regulation, varying between both high and low degrees.

A policy of equal opportunity employment is adopted by Coca-Cola Consolidated, Inc.

Employment opportunities are available to qualified individuals, without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.description:
Company Statement

Graham Packaging is a people, planet and values-based company and a leader in sustainable packaging manufacturing. From the kitchen to the laundry room, Graham Packaging is part of your everyday life. For employees at Graham, our Blue Culture is part of their everyday lives, too. In other words, Blue is how we do things here. At Graham, we are united by a clear vision. We know our part and help those around us know theirs, encouraging one another to continuously improve. We create a safe, challenging environment to innovate by supporting creative ideas and new ways of thinking. We take the initiative to cultivate our individual growth and help others do the same, while keeping ourselves and one another accountable. And we actively promote cooperation, collaboration, integrity and respect across regions and teams to foster an engaged, diverse and connected workforce. We value our employees, and a Blue Culture allows for the most rewarding employee experience as part of the Graham family. Blue is how we feel about what we do- together to create a better tomorrow. Working at Graham means you lead constructively with clear goals, use diverse thinking to drive excellence, accountability, innovation, as well as demonstrating collaboration, embracing learning, and taking action for continuous improvement and growth.

Overview

Graham Packaging Company is looking for a Forklift Operator based in West Chicago (St. Charles) IL.

Opening is9:00 am- 5:00 pm Monday-Friday.

Starting wage is $ 23.45

Forklift Operators perform a combination of product handling and lift truck operating duties to stack, transport, and store work-in-process and finished goods. Supplies production lines with efficient flow of materials - knockdowns and dividers - and moves finished goods to warehouse. Complete line driver reports accurately and legible showing locations and quantities of raw materials used as well as quantities and locations where finished goods were stored. Assist production line employees by relieving them in breaks and lunchtime periods. The primary duties of a Forklift Operator include:
  • Follow all established safety, health, quality GMP and Company policies, procedures and recognized practices.
  • Perform a safety lift truck inspection and battery check and report any equipment malfunctioning or damage to the Warehouse Manager or Shift Supervisor. Change lift truck batteries and add water when necessary; keep record of time batteries are changed. Fill out lift truck status report.
  • Participate in continuous quality improvement projects and other related activities as assigned.
  • Review daily production schedule with Shift Supervisor, brings materials to the production lines when needed to execute schedule and notify supervisor of any materials running low. Removes finished goods from production lines, back to assigned warehouse locations.
  • Provide accurate information of unloaded materials as well as materials used or produced to warehouse personnel.
  • Remove, store, and unitize production scrap bales and informs warehouse personnel when there is enough for a full load. Removes excess corrugated from mezzanine and empties baler as required. Takes full bales of cardboard scrap from baler to assigned location in the warehouse.
  • Maintain accurate records of materials being used and produced, and reports them in appropriate paperwork, back to warehouse personnel.
  • Remove finished goods and other materials in hold to assigned location. Stores finished goods stacked neatly and in proper height. Verifies that all finished goods removed from the production area must have a product code tag.
  • Participate in physical inventory taking.
  • Keep each production line supplied with the proper knock down cases, dividers, pallets and when each pallet is full take that pallet to the warehouse for loading on the trailer; and takes unused cases and dividers back to the warehouse to the proper location.
  • On limited production, may assist in stock-handler duties or load trailers as needed.
  • Bring up hot glue cases to the mezzanine, brings color concentrate to the lines, replaces cold glue tote, removes excess cases from production floor, brings slip sheets to production floor, loads storage racks with gaylords, set up rework, set up units of product on hold for Q.C., relieves stock handlers, loads and unloads corrugated trailers, identifies good corrugated from the bad and isolates it.
  • Follow established forklift procedures and complete required safety and maintenance checklists
  • Follow established procedures for damaged finished goods and raw materials and report them on line driver report.
  • Communicate with supervisor regarding shift totals and machine totals reports and with other lift truck operators regarding any changes or problems that arise, including damaged materials, damaged skids, or low inventories.
  • Complete written documentation as required.
  • Assist in relieving downstream teammates for breaks and lunches.
  • Use forklift to move pallets of finished product to stretch wrap machines to stretch wrap them and to staging area after wrapping, or to specify warehouse location. Completes finished goods report or worksheet.
  • Maintain supplies of corrugated and other packaging supplies at each machine.
  • Visually inspect all completed pallets of product for quality and conformity to the packaging instructions to ensure quality at the source.
  • Limited travel may be required.

Qualifications

Minimum of 1 year forklift experience preferred.

Forklift Operators are required to interact with other managers, employees, vendors, and customers. Therefore, the following skills and proficiencies are also essential requirements of the position:

  • Ability to maintain regular, predictable, and punctual attendance.
  • Computer usage and typing skills are essential.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, including the ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers.
  • Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service.
  • Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices.
  • Communicates effectively: conveys facts and information clearly both verbally and orally.
  • Collaborates well with others: proactively contributes to group objectives; volunteers to help others.

Compensation Statement

The expected salary range for the position described in this posting is made in accordance with the legal mandates of certain jurisdictions within the United States. The final agreed-upon compensation is based on individual qualifications and experience.

Benefits Statement

Benefits include medical, dental, vision and basic life insurance. Employees are able to enroll in the company’s 401K Employee Saving Plan and may participate in its Employee Wellness Program. Employees will also receive paid time off in accordance with company policy and state law requirements.

EEO Disclaimer

Graham Packaging is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, religion, creed, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling, the industry leading manufacturer of beverages, is seeking skilled candidates to join its team

Come be a part of our team if you already love our products!

Additionally, this position may be eligible to take part in a discretionary perks program, subject to the conventions governing the plan.

Position Summary:

The key responsibility of an Warehouse Assistant is to assist departments like manufacturing, transportation, operations, warehouse, and more by handling day-to-day administrative tasks.

This job may require performing a range of tasks that are not limited to the ones listed:

  • You will also be required to monitor service performance, track the progress of delivery operations, and keep accurate records. To ensure that all delivery services are carried out satisfactorily, you will constantly explore strategies for improvement.
  • A wide spectrum of administrative responsibilities may be assigned, which may include office support and drafting correspondence
  • Operational reports should be accurate, up-to-date, and relevant to the business objectives and goals of the organization

What You'll Do

  • This role centers on your professional skills within the Logistics space in East Chicago.

Mastering the Overnight Middle Mile

If the fulfillment center is the brain of the operation, the sortation center is the central nervous system. Welcome to the critical "middle mile" of the Amazon delivery network. As a Night Shift Sortation Warehouse Associate, your primary objective is to group and route thousands of packages during the graveyard hours so they reach the correct local delivery hubs right at dawn. For those seeking highly active, fast-paced night shift warehouse jobs that offer intense teamwork and rapid physical movement, this is the ultimate environment.

The Overnight Sortation Experience

Work in a sort center is fundamentally different from a traditional fulfillment role. You are not picking individual items; you are dealing with sealed, completed packages that are moving rapidly down vast networks of conveyor belts. The atmosphere at night is charged, highly focused, and incredibly team-oriented. When the conveyor belts get heavily loaded during the midnight "rush," you will rely on your night-owl teammates to clear the lines and keep the supply chain moving seamlessly.

  1. Rapid Package Routing: You will read complex digital routing labels as packages fly down the line, pulling them off the belt and sorting them into specific geographical chutes or designated postal carts.
  2. Pallet Architecture: You will become a master of spatial reasoning. Sorting requires building perfectly stable, tightly packed pallets of boxes (often referred to as "playing Tetris" by our veteran associates), which are then heavily shrink-wrapped to prevent transit damage.
  3. Fluid Loading Operations: Utilizing manual pallet jacks, you will safely transport these massive, wrapped pallets directly into the bellies of outbound 18-wheeler semi-trailers, staging them for the early morning over-the-road drivers.

"The night sort center moves incredibly fast, but the overnight shift premium is what keeps me here. Working the graveyard shift allows me to manage my college classes during the day while still getting access to Amazon's incredible 401(k) matching and tuition assistance. The night crew is like a family." - A current Night Sortation Associate.

Flexibility and Night Shift Rewards

We understand that modern life requires flexible schedules. Sortation roles offer some of the most adaptable late-night shifts in the logistics careers landscape, including midnight to morning or late evening options. Associates unlock exceptional health, dental, and vision benefits, along with highly competitive shift differentials that significantly boost your base pay when working non-traditional hours. You will need a strong commitment to workplace safety, the ability to lift up to 49 pounds, and a High School diploma or equivalent to join the night team.

Job Summary:

Target takes pride in its top-ranking position among retailers in the US. Its aim is to make daily life for families as enjoyable and stress-free as possible with its superior product and service offerings.

Roles and Duties:

  • Undertake safety measures and protocols to ensure the protection of every team member and promote a secure workplace culture.

  • Demonstrates a courteous and optimistic demeanor when working independently or within a group setting.

Requirements:

  • Capable of regularly handling and carrying merchandise that weigh between 35-50 pounds throughout the duration of a workday.
  • Able to transport goods weighing up to 60 pounds from time to time throughout the workday.
  • Perform actions that involve standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching repetitively during shifts.
  • A positive and respectful approach is crucial to succeeding in both solo projects and team efforts.
  • Skilled in proficiently applying elementary mathematical concepts like counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Demonstrating the talent to effectively read and understand the information on product documentation, labels, and tickets.
  • Competent use of computer systems and handheld devices can be achieved with little supervision after appropriate training.
  • Being a strong communicator can improve teamwork, collaboration, and overall productivity in any work environment
  • Understanding and complying with safety policies, procedures, and instructions require a reasonable level of proficiency in English to read, speak, and understand directives.

Additional Requirements:

  • Competent in handling all powered equipment with proper safety precautions, including Scissor Lift, Pallet Rider, Sit-Down, and Standup Forklift, and capable of working at a height of up to 40ft when required.
  • Conduct work operations at a height of up to 40 ft on a mezzanine level, as appropriate
  • Comfortable working in varying temperature conditions, such as refrigerated or frozen environments, for the duration of the shift.

Benefits:

Target team members are offered a range of benefits, provided they meet the necessary criteria and adhere to the terms and conditions of the eligibility criteria.

jobs.title: Vice President, Solution Sales - Distribution & Fulfillment (P/LS)
jobs.description:
ITS Logistics is a leading Third-Party Logistics provider and an Echo Global Logistics company. We run a fully integrated platform - asset-based truckload, Dedicated & Fulfillment, LTL, Dray, Intermodal, and Managed Transportation - plus Roadtex, our temperature-controlled warehouse and distribution network. That combination gives our customers something most 3PLs can't offer: a single partner who can handle ambient fulfillment, confectionery-grade temp-controlled distribution, and everything in between.

We're a performance-driven organization. We invest in our people, give them real commercial infrastructure to work with, and get out of their way. If you're looking for a place where your output actually matters, this is it.

Want to learn more about ITS Logistics? Check out our website! www.its4logistics.com

About the Position

We're looking for a proven hunter who has spent their career selling warehouse and fulfillment solutions into the pharmaceutical and life sciences space - and who understands that in this vertical, compliance capability is the sale, not a checkbox.

This role sells the full ITS + Roadtex D&F platform: ITS omnichannel ambient warehouse and fulfillment for CPG manufacturers, food shippers, and e-commerce customers, and Roadtex temperature-controlled (confectionery-grade, 55–65°F) warehouse, distribution, and value-added services for customers who need food-safe, OTIF-compliant, retail-ready distribution.

There is no existing book to manage. You will prospect, qualify, design solutions, and close - from first call through contract. The platform is differentiated. The opportunity is real. We need someone who can execute.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect and close new business within the pharma and life sciences vertical - targeting pharmaceutical manufacturers, specialty distributors, clinical logistics providers, medical device companies, and nutraceutical brands.
  • Sell the full ITS + Roadtex D&F platform: ambient omnichannel fulfillment (ITS) and confectionery-grade temperature-controlled warehouse, distribution, and VAS (Roadtex).
  • Build and manage your own pipeline from scratch. Qualify opportunities, design integrated solutions, coordinate pricing, and lead pursuit cycles through close.
  • Engage VP and C-suite supply chain, logistics, and procurement contacts. This is not a coordinator-level sales motion.
  • Build multi-service proposals and ROI models - combining ambient warehouse, temp-controlled storage, VAS, and transportation into a single integrated solution.
  • Work with ITS and Roadtex operations and pricing teams to validate solutions operationally before proposals go out.
  • Use the Echo enterprise account base to identify cross-sell opportunities for ITS D&F and Roadtex capabilities.
  • Keep CRM clean - accurate deal values, stages, timelines, and probabilities on every active opportunity.
  • Transition closed accounts cleanly to the Enterprise Account Management team and stay involved where needed to protect revenue actualization.
  • Show up at trade events, customer meetings, and industry forums specific to food and nutrition supply chain.
  • Give leadership straight pipeline reporting - what's real, what's at risk, what's closing.

A bout the Requirements

  • 7+ years as an individual contributor selling 3PL warehouse and fulfillment solutions. Not sales management - field sales, closing deals.
  • You've consistently closed $12M+ per year in new logo warehouse and fulfillment revenue within the food, beverage, or nutrition space. We'll ask for specifics.
  • You built that pipeline yourself. Not from marketing programs, not from account lists handed to you. You know how to generate your own opportunities.
  • You are actively hunting in your current role - not managing accounts, not renewing contracts. You find new business and close it.
  • The product you've been selling is warehouse and fulfillment - physical 3PL services. Not transportation brokerage, not TMS, not managed services.
  • You understand how shippers evaluate 3PL outsourcing decisions - the RFP process, the stakeholders involved, how multi-year contracts get structured and won.
  • You've sold into food, beverage, nutrition, or CPG verticals and understand the compliance environment: OTIF, MABD, retail routing guide requirements.
  • You can engage confidently at VP and C-suite level and lead a complex, multi-stakeholder sales process without hand-holding.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.

This job operates in an office environment and uses a computer, telephone and other office equipment as needed to perform duties. jobs.title: Warehouse Associate - 2nd Shift - Days Off: Tuesdays & Wednesdays
jobs.description:
Warehouse Associate - 2nd Shift

Warehouse associates will ensure the needs of both production and warehouse are met throughout their respective shifts by the timely and safe delivery, shipping, and receiving of produce and packaged goods.

Detailed Responsibilities

Receiving

  • Will apply glad hand lock and wheel chocks for any trailer to unload
  • Will assist FSQA and receivers with breakdown of pallets for quality checks and to transport to storage
  • When produce or packaged good are received in the associate will place produce/packaged goods into correct storage
  • Placed produce/packaging must be staged according to FIFO and in correct temperature storage location and remove any plastic from produce that needs to breathe
  • Notify leadership if any product is found to be out of correct location
  • Work on creating space for inbound loads
  • Ensure all storage pods are kept free of debris

Replenishing

  • Set floor for decanting and shipping lines per drop list and boxing call out
  • All packaging material is set for box team, shipping lines, and decanting area
  • Prior to production running completely out of product, the warehouse associate will bring out the requested material according to the production's count.
  • Answer call of any additional product needs for production
  • Move anything needed for production, warehouse, sanitation, or FSQA
  • Prior to leaving for any break, warehouse associates will check with the production team as well as make a visual check of produce/packaging in use to ensure the area is fully stocked before leaving production area.
  • Near the end of each shift remove any material from the drop zone as well as the return area that production will not use for the incoming shift. All product is returned to home location
  • Ensure all pallets in storage are front faced, leveled, and plastic removed
  • Warehouse associate is responsible for organization of assigned storage areas

Shipping

  • Check all trailers loaded on the shipping dock for trash or pine pallets, remove any items found that are not needed for completed shipments
  • Put on glad hand lock on trailer and chock wheels prior to being loaded
  • Using the load diagram form load trucks with completed pallets with management approval - full load 26 pallets
  • Once the trailer has been fully loaded, place a FedEx seal on the closed trailer door to signify ready for ship and put the serial number for the load seal on the load diagram form and we remove the glad hand lock. Turn in paperwork to leadership

Support other Warehouse functions

  • We are one team. Team members are expected to assist with completing any function needed for our company to deliver finished goods to the customer. This includes using any equipment certified on or assisting other departments to get the job done for the day.

General Responsibilities

  • Follow all safety procedures throughout execution of all tasks. This includes, but is not limited to, performing pre-shift equipment checks for all equipment used and wearing required PPE. Safety first!
  • Follow the facility GMPs and help enforce them throughout the facility.
  • Sign for all equipment needed to perform your duties. Ensure these are signed back in upon completion of shift.
  • Support the efforts of the company to maintain our food safety system (SQF) and quality programs. Quality always!
  • Be respectful of others. Team members are expected to carry themselves in a professional manner in all situations and at all times.

Qualifications

  • General high school degree, or equivalent, (e.g. GED). GED or High School diploma required
  • Willing to learn how to operate equipment needed to perform all warehouse duties including, but not limited to, manual and electric pallet jack and hand held scanners.
  • Able to lift up to 50lbs
  • Previous warehouse experience preferred

Join our team as a Warehouse Associate / Record Center Specialist in Chicago, where you will enjoy steady hours, competitive weekly pay, and a direct path to permanent employment. Job Summary

We are seeking a bilingual dedicated and energetic Janitorial Specialist to maintain cleanliness and safety within a busy warehouse environment. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the facility remains spotless, sanitized, and well-maintained, supporting a safe and efficient workspace for all team members. Your proactive approach to cleaning, equipment handling, and safety adherence will help uphold our high standards of sanitation and facility upkeep. This position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals with janitorial or custodial experience who thrive in fast-paced settings and take pride in their work.

Duties

  • Perform comprehensive cleaning tasks across the warehouse, including sweeping, mopping, dusting, and trash removal to maintain a tidy environment.
  • Operate various cleaning equipment such as floor buffers, scrubbers, and vacuums to ensure optimal floor care and sanitation.
  • Handle chemical agents safely by following proper chemical handling safety procedures, including mixing, storage, and disposal.
  • Conduct heavy lifting and manual handling of cleaning supplies, equipment, and waste materials while adhering to safe lifting practices.
  • Maintain sanitation standards by disinfecting high-touch surfaces and ensuring compliance with safety protocols at all times.
  • Support facilities maintenance activities such as minor repairs or reporting issues that require specialized attention.
  • Assist with industrial cleaning tasks including the use of specialized tools for large-scale cleaning projects in the warehouse setting.
  • Provide excellent customer service by responding promptly to cleaning requests or concerns from team members or supervisors.

Experience

  • Prior janitorial or custodial experience in a commercial or industrial setting is preferred.
  • Proven ability to operate cleaning equipment such as floor buffers and scrubbers effectively.
  • Knowledge of chemical agent handling safety procedures and sanitation standards.
  • Experience with heavy lifting and manual handling in a warehouse or facilities environment.
  • Familiarity with safety protocol adherence related to custodial work, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Background in facilities maintenance or industrial cleaning is advantageous.
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to maintaining high cleanliness standards in busy environments.

Join our team as a Janitorial Specialist and play a vital role in creating a safe, clean, and welcoming warehouse environment! Your dedication to quality cleaning practices combined with your safety awareness will ensure our facility remains efficient and compliant while supporting our team’s success.

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Job Posting Title

Production Lift Truck Driver 2nd Shift

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a reliable, safety-conscious Forklift Operator to support our manufacturing operations. The Forklift Operator is responsible for safely transporting materials throughout the facility to ensure uninterrupted production. This position plays a key role in maintaining inventory accuracy, supporting shipping and receiving operations, and meeting customer delivery requirements.

Job Description:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Safely operate forklifts in accordance with OSHA regulations and company policies.
  • Supply production lines with materials according to production schedules.
  • Stage materials for production, shipping, and storage.
  • Verify material quantities, labels, and locations before movement.
  • Utilize RF scanners, barcode systems, or warehouse management systems to complete inventory transactions.
  • Perform pre-shift inspections of forklifts and report equipment issues promptly.
  • Assist with inventory counts, cycle counts, and inventory reconciliation.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas.
  • Follow all safety, quality, environmental, and company policies.
  • Support Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to operate powered industrial equipment for extended periods.
  • Frequently stand, walk, bend, reach, and twist throughout the workday.
  • Lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Must meet vision and physical requirements necessary for safe forklift operation.

Required Skills and Education

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
